titleByLocale.en: Business Strategist, UBS Chief Strategy Office - GWM
titleByLocale.it: Business Strategist, UBS Chief Strategy Office - GWM
titleByLocale.de: Business Strategist, UBS Chief Strategy Office - GWM
titleByLocale.fr: Stratégiste des affaires, Bureau stratégique en chef de l'UBS - GWM

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role
Do you have a strategic mindset to engage with senior stakeholders? Do you have strong problem solving skills and do you enjoy bringing structure to complex situations, engage with a variety of views and stakeholders to find common solutions? Are you good at communicating complex business challenges in a constructive and easy way?

We are looking for someone who wants to:
• drive the development of the GWM strategy on a global, country, channel and product level, together with the respective businesses
• support the decision making of our internal business partners on senior management level
• conduct industry, competitor and benchmarking analyses
• design operating models and processes for specific markets and business segments
• coordinate and challenge business plans including financial modelling
• develop implementation roadmaps of strategic initiatives
• drive M&A projects from a strategic perspective (rationale, financial opportunity, due diligence, etc.)
• be open to do cross-divisional strategy projects/rotations as opportunities arise
descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo ruolo
Hai una mentalità strategica per impegnarsi con gli stakeholder senior? Hai forti capacità di problem solving e ti piace portare la struttura in situazioni complesse, impegnarsi con una varietà di punti di vista e stakeholder per trovare soluzioni comuni? Sei bravo a comunicare complesse sfide aziendali in modo costruttivo e facile?

Stiamo cercando qualcuno che vuole:
• guidare lo sviluppo della strategia GWM a livello globale, nazionale, canale e prodotto, insieme alle rispettive aziende
• sostenere il processo decisionale dei nostri partner commerciali interni a livello di gestione senior
• condurre analisi industriali, concorrenti e benchmarking
• modelli operativi di progettazione e processi per mercati specifici e segmenti aziendali
• coordinare e sfidare i piani aziendali, compresa la modellazione finanziaria
• sviluppare roadmap di attuazione delle iniziative strategiche
• guidare progetti M&A da una prospettiva strategica (rationale, opportunità finanziarie, due diligence, ecc.)
• essere aperti a fare progetti/rotazioni di strategia interdivisionale come opportunitÃ
descriptionByLocale.de:
Deine Rolle
Haben Sie eine strategische Denkweise, um mit Senior Stakeholdern zu interagieren? Haben Sie starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung und bringen Sie gerne Struktur in komplexe Situationen, engagieren Sie sich mit einer Vielzahl von Ansichten und Stakeholdern, um gemeinsame Lösungen zu finden? Sind Sie gut darin, komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen konstruktiv und einfach zu kommunizieren?

Wir suchen jemanden, der möchte:
• die Entwicklung der GWM-Strategie auf globaler, Länder-, Channel- und Produktebene gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Unternehmen voranzutreiben
• Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung unserer internen Geschäftspartner auf Führungsebene
• Durchführung von Branchen-, Wettbewerber- und Benchmarking-Analysen
• Gestaltung von Betriebsmodellen und Prozessen für spezifische Märkte und Geschäftsfelder
• Koordination und Herausforderung von Geschäftsplänen einschließlich Finanzmodellierung
• Entwicklung von Umsetzungsfahrplänen für strategische Initiativen
• M&A-Projekte aus einer strategischen Perspektive (rationale, finanzielle Möglichkeiten, Due Diligence, etc.)
• Seien Sie offen für bereichsübergreifende Strategieprojekte / Rotationen, wenn sich Chancen ergeben
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre rôle
Avez-vous un état d'esprit stratégique pour dialoguer avec les principaux intervenants? Avez-vous de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et aimez-vous apporter une structure à des situations complexes, s'engager avec une variété de points de vue et d'intervenants pour trouver des solutions communes? Êtes-vous doué pour communiquer de façon constructive et facile les défis complexes d'affaires?

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui veut :
• stimuler le développement de la stratégie GWM au niveau mondial, national, des canaux et des produits, en collaboration avec les entreprises concernées;
• soutenir la prise de décision de nos partenaires commerciaux internes au niveau de la haute direction
• réaliser des analyses de l'industrie, des concurrents et des analyses comparatives
• concevoir des modèles d'exploitation et des processus pour des marchés et des secteurs d'activité spécifiques
• coordonner et remettre en question les plans d'activités, y compris la modélisation financière
• élaborer des feuilles de route pour la mise en œuvre des initiatives stratégiques;
• conduire les projets de fusion et d'acquisition d'une perspective stratégique (rationale, opportunité financière, diligence raisonnable, etc.)
• être ouvert à faire des projets/rotations stratégiques interdivisions au fur et à mesure des opportunités;

titleByLocale.it: Analista delle Operazioni di Sorveglianza del Commercio
titleByLocale.fr: Analyste des opérations de surveillance commerciale

descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione
- Your role :

Requisiti
- Do you like financial markets?
- Are you good at handling and interpreting large data sets?
- Are you analytical and enjoy investigating financial transactions, understanding trading strategies and making sense of the unusual trading activity?
- Are you able to think independently and express your opinions and ideas confidently?

Mansioni
- Performing automated and manual market conduct surveillance activities across Investment Bank and Wealth Management division.
- Analyzing instances of potentially suspicious activities flagged by our systems.
- Engaging with business stakeholders on the market conduct-related escalations and other matters.
- Driving continuous process improvements and contributing to strategic projects and automation/optimization initiatives.
- Conducting information barrier trade surveillance for firm, customer, and employee personal account dealing (PAD) Monitor the flow of material nonpublic information (MNPI) to detect potential breaches of the firm's Information Barrier Policy, restricted list, and insider trading.

Cosa offriamo
- This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione - Il tuo ruolo: Requisiti - Ti piacciono i mercati finanziari? - Sei bravo a gestire e interpretare grandi set di dati? - Sei analitico e ti piace indagare sulle transazioni finanziarie, comprendere le strategie di trading e dare un senso all'insolita attività di trading? - Sei in grado di pensare in modo indipendente ed esprimere le tue opinioni e idee con sicurezza? Mansioni - Esecuzione di attività automatizzate e manuali di sorveglianza della condotta del mercato nella divisione Investment Bank e Wealth Management. - Analizzare i casi di attività potenzialmente sospette segnalate dai nostri sistemi. - Coinvolgere le parti interessate aziendali sulle escalation relative alla condotta del mercato e su altre questioni. - Promuovere miglioramenti continui dei processi e contribuire a progetti strategici e iniziative di automazione/ottimizzazione. - Condurre la sorveglianza sulle barriere commerciali delle informazioni per le transazioni sui conti personali di aziende, clienti e dipendenti (PAD). Monitorare il flusso di informazioni materiali non pubbliche (MNPI) per rilevare potenziali violazioni della politica sulle barriere informative dell'azienda, dell'elenco limitato e dell'insider trading. Cosa offriamo - Questa descrizione del lavoro fornisce una revisione di alto livello delle tipologie di lavoro svolte. Altri compiti legati al lavoro possono essere assegnati secondo necessità.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung – Ihre Rolle: Anforderungen – Gefallen Ihnen Finanzmärkte? - Sind Sie gut im Umgang und in der Interpretation großer Datenmengen? - Sie sind analytisch und haben Spaß daran, Finanztransaktionen zu untersuchen, Handelsstrategien zu verstehen und ungewöhnliche Handelsaktivitäten zu verstehen? - Können Sie selbstständig denken und Ihre Meinungen und Ideen selbstbewusst äußern? Mansioni – Durchführung automatisierter und manueller Marktverhaltensüberwachungsaktivitäten in der gesamten Investment Bank- und Wealth Management-Abteilung. - Analyse von Fällen potenziell verdächtiger Aktivitäten, die von unseren Systemen gemeldet werden. - Kontaktaufnahme mit Geschäftsinteressenten zu Eskalationen im Zusammenhang mit dem Marktverhalten und anderen Angelegenheiten. - Vorantreiben kontinuierlicher Prozessverbesserungen und Mitwirken an strategischen Projekten und Automatisierungs-/Optimierungsinitiativen. - Durchführung einer Überwachung des Handels mit Informationsbarrieren für den Privatkundenhandel (PAD) von Unternehmen, Kunden und Mitarbeitern. Überwachen Sie den Fluss wesentlicher nicht öffentlicher Informationen (MNPI), um potenzielle Verstöße gegen die Richtlinie zu Informationsbarrieren, Sperrlisten und Insiderhandel des Unternehmens zu erkennen. Cosa offriamo – Diese Stellenbeschreibung bietet einen allgemeinen Überblick über die Art der ausgeführten Arbeiten. Bei Bedarf können weitere berufsbezogene Aufgaben übertragen werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione - Votre rôle : Requisiti - Vous aimez les marchés financiers ? - Êtes-vous doué pour gérer et interpréter de grands ensembles de données ? - Êtes-vous analytique et aimez-vous enquêter sur les transactions financières, comprendre les stratégies de trading et donner un sens aux activités de trading inhabituelles ? - Êtes-vous capable de penser de manière indépendante et d'exprimer vos opinions et vos idées avec confiance ? Mansioni - Réalisation d'activités de surveillance automatisées et manuelles des pratiques de marché au sein de la division Banque d'investissement et gestion de patrimoine. - Analyser les cas d'activités potentiellement suspectes signalés par nos systèmes. - S'engager avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise sur les escalades liées à la conduite du marché et sur d'autres questions. - Conduire des améliorations continues des processus et contribuer aux projets stratégiques et aux initiatives d'automatisation/optimisation. - Effectuer une surveillance commerciale des barrières d'information pour les transactions sur les comptes personnels de l'entreprise, des clients et des employés (PAD). Surveiller le flux d'informations importantes non publiques (MNPI) pour détecter les violations potentielles de la politique de barrière à l'information de l'entreprise, de la liste restreinte et des délits d'initiés. Cosa ofriamo - Cette description de poste fournit un aperçu de haut niveau des types de travail effectués. D'autres tâches liées au poste peuvent être assignées selon les besoins.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have a desire to break into Advisory Sales within Global Markets? Are you a target driven individual? Do you know how to come up with innovative solutions for clients?

We're looking for a junior Markets Salesperson to:
• provide sales backup to the Multi Product Sales team in New York – the role will be 5 days/week on the New York trading desk
• work closely with the teams on analyst marketing schedules, company roadshows, capital markets transactions and client engagement events
• provide business expense support and timely submission of team expenses
• support internal projects and distribution initiatives
• role will be a stepping-stone toward a long career in Markets Sales, with the progression being based on the individual’s development in Global Markets, Cross Product, team support and client relationships
• work with AI driven sales technology to find efficiencies around the client coverage process
descriptionByLocale.it:
Avete il desiderio di entrare in vendite consultive all'interno dei mercati globali? Sei un individuo guidato da un bersaglio? Sai come trovare soluzioni innovative per i clienti?

Stiamo cercando un venditore di mercati junior a:
• fornire il backup delle vendite al team di vendite multi prodotto a New York – il ruolo sarà 5 giorni / settimana sul banco di trading di New York
• lavorare a stretto contatto con i team sui programmi di marketing degli analisti, roadshow aziendali, transazioni sui mercati dei capitali e eventi di impegno dei clienti
• fornire supporto alle spese aziendali e tempestiva presentazione delle spese di squadra
• sostenere progetti interni e iniziative di distribuzione
• ruolo sarà un passo avanti verso una lunga carriera nelle vendite di mercati, con la progressione basata sullo sviluppo individuale in Global Markets, Cross Product, supporto di team e relazioni con i clienti
• lavorare con la tecnologia di vendita guidata AI per trovare efficienze intorno al processo di copertura del cliente
descriptionByLocale.de:
Haben Sie den Wunsch, in Advisory Sales in Global Markets einzusteigen? Sind Sie ein zielgerichtetes Individuum? Wissen Sie, wie Sie innovative Lösungen für Kunden entwickeln können?

Wir suchen einen Junior Markets Salesperson für:
• Verkaufssicherung für das Multi Product Sales Team in New York - die Rolle wird 5 Tage / Woche auf dem New Yorker Trading Desk sein
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams bei Analysten-Marketing-Zeitplänen, Roadshows von Unternehmen, Kapitalmarkttransaktionen und Kundenbindungsveranstaltungen
• Unterstützung der Geschäftskosten und rechtzeitige Einreichung der Teamkosten
• Unterstützung interner Projekte und Vertriebsinitiativen
• Die Rolle wird ein Sprungbrett für eine lange Karriere im Markets Sales sein, wobei der Fortschritt auf der Entwicklung des Einzelnen in Global Markets, Cross Product, Teamsupport und Kundenbeziehungen basiert.
• Arbeiten Sie mit KI-gesteuerter Vertriebstechnologie, um Effizienz rund um den Kundenabdeckungsprozess zu finden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Avez-vous le désir de pénétrer dans les ventes-conseils au sein des marchés mondiaux? Êtes-vous une personne ciblée? Savez-vous trouver des solutions innovantes pour vos clients ?

Nous cherchons un vendeur junior pour :
• fournir des renforts commerciaux à l'équipe des ventes multiproduits à New York – le rôle sera de 5 jours/semaine sur le bureau de commerce de New York
• travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes sur les calendriers de marketing des analystes, les tournées de l'entreprise, les transactions sur les marchés financiers et les événements d'engagement des clients
• fournir un appui aux dépenses de fonctionnement et présenter les dépenses de l'équipe en temps voulu;
• soutenir des projets internes et des initiatives de distribution
• rôle sera un tremplin vers une longue carrière dans Markets Sales, la progression étant basée sur le développement individuel dans Global Markets, Cross Product, le soutien de l'équipe et les relations client
• travailler avec la technologie de vente AI pour trouver des gains d'efficacité autour du processus de couverture client

descriptionByLocale.en:
Role:
This role will continue to drive key responsibilities within the STAAT Analytics team. The candidate will lead the development of scalable, insight-driven dashboards and advanced analytical solutions that empower strategic decision-making for financial advisory and market leadership. The role requires a strong ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, ensuring stakeholders have the tools and intelligence needed to optimize performance and identify growth opportunities.
Responsibilities :
• Apply a structured, analytical approach to address complex business challenges leveraging Python and SQL.
• Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis and develop predictive models to drive key strategic initiatives.
• Translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications and innovative data-driven solutions.
• Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for real-time KPI tracking across financial advisory and market segments.
• Implement advanced dashboard features such as dynamic filtering, intuitive search functionality, and peer comparison tools to optimize user engagement.
• Integrate data from diverse sources, including ADW, BODI, and internal data marts, ensuring accuracy and consistency across analytics outputs.
• Automate data pipelines and reporting workflows using Python and Power BI, enhancing efficiency and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure analytics deliverables are aligned with overarching business objectives.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Role:
Questo ruolo continuerà a guidare responsabilità chiave nel team STAAT Analytics. Il candidato porterà lo sviluppo di dashboard scalabili, orientati agli approfondimenti e soluzioni analitiche avanzate che potenziano il processo decisionale strategico per la consulenza finanziaria e la leadership di mercato. Il ruolo richiede una forte capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight attuabili, assicurando agli stakeholder gli strumenti e l'intelligenza necessari per ottimizzare le prestazioni e identificare le opportunità di crescita.
Responsabile:
• Applicare un approccio strutturato e analitico per affrontare complesse sfide aziendali sfruttando Python e SQL.
• Condurre analisi complete dei dati esplorativi e sviluppare modelli predittivi per guidare iniziative strategiche chiave.
• Tradurre i requisiti aziendali in specifiche tecniche attuabili e soluzioni innovative basate sui dati.
• Progettazione, sviluppo e manutenzione cruscotti Power BI interattivi per il monitoraggio KPI in tempo reale su segmenti di consulenza finanziaria e di mercato.
• Implementare funzionalità di dashboard avanzate come filtraggio dinamico, funzionalità di ricerca intuitiva e strumenti di confronto peer per ottimizzare l'impegno dell'utente.
• Integrare i dati provenienti da diverse fonti, tra cui ADW, BODI e data mart interni, garantendo precisione e coerenza tra le uscite di analisi.
• Automatizzare i flussi di dati e segnalare i flussi di lavoro utilizzando Python e Power BI, migliorando efficienza e affidabilità.
• Collaborare con i team interfunzionali per garantire che i responsabili dell'analisi siano allineati con obiettivi aziendali overarching.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Rolle:
Diese Rolle wird weiterhin wichtige Verantwortlichkeiten innerhalb des STAAT Analytics-Teams bestimmen. Der Kandidat wird die Entwicklung skalierbarer, aufschlussreicher Dashboards und fortschrittlicher analytischer Lösungen leiten, die strategische Entscheidungen für Finanzberatung und Marktführerschaft ermöglichen. Die Rolle erfordert eine starke Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Stakeholder über die erforderlichen Werkzeuge und Informationen verfügen, um die Leistung zu optimieren und Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren.
Zuständigkeiten :
• Wenden Sie einen strukturierten, analytischen Ansatz an, um komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen mit Python und SQL zu bewältigen.
• Durchführung umfassender Sondierungsdatenanalysen und Entwicklung prädiktiver Modelle, um wichtige strategische Initiativen voranzutreiben.
• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in umsetzbare technische Spezifikationen und innovative datengesteuerte Lösungen.
Design, Entwicklung und Pflege interaktiver Power BI Dashboards für die Echtzeit-KPI-Tracking in Finanzberatung und Marktsegmenten.
Implementieren Sie erweiterte Dashboard-Funktionen wie dynamische Filterung, intuitive Suchfunktionalität und Peer-Vergleichstools, um die Benutzerbindung zu optimieren.
Integrieren Sie Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen, einschließlich ADW, BODI und internen Data Marts, um Genauigkeit und Konsistenz in allen Analyseergebnissen zu gewährleisten.
• Automatisieren Sie Datenpipelines und Reporting-Workflows mit Python und Power BI, wodurch Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit verbessert werden.
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ergebnisse von Analysen auf die übergreifenden Geschäftsziele ausgerichtet sind.

Responsabilités :
• Appliquer une approche structurée et analytique pour relever les défis complexes de l'entreprise en exploitant Python et SQL.

• Traduire les exigences opérationnelles en spécifications techniques réalisables et en solutions innovantes axées sur les données.
• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord interactifs Power BI pour le suivi en temps réel de KPI sur les segments de conseil financier et de marché.

• serve as a point of contact for issues that cannot be resolved, and escalate issues as required

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.

• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

• We are seeking an experienced candidate to join our Cash Equities CRB Quantitative Developer team within UBS Global Markets
• This is a fast paced and collaborative team that are responsible for the development and enhancement of the best-in-class Cash Equities platform
• The team sits within the Global Markets Principal Flow Trading stream, and has a business reporting line
• You will be operating within a high-performing, fast paced quant development team, whose goals are directly aligned to the success of the business
• You will take ownership of initiatives from initial analysis through to design, implementation and delivery

o Market connectivity
o Designing, implementing and back-testing hedging, risk management and execution strategies
o Designing and building analytics to assess model and platform performance
o Latency analysis and optimisation
o Enhancing the proprietary eTrading framework that is used across the department

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you looking for a new challenge within the fast-paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Are you curious, proactive, and always striving to bring positive impact to clients? We’re looking for a Tade and Client Service Specialist to:
• Support Client Advisors in UK & Jersey
• Process client orders on an execution only basis covering equities, ETF's, fixed income, structured products, FX options, SPI's and hedge funds.

• Carry out daily transaction processing and complex troubleshooting in line with WMUK & Jersey trading rules

• Ensure all risk management controls are adhered to in order to identify and mitigate any potential risk and appropriate management information (MI) is produced
• Manage the input and release of payments for the Jersey business.
• Perform call backs on payments that fall within the relevant thresholds.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a sharp evaluator of risk, who enjoys investigating complex business processes and products? Do you want to play a key role in improving the effectiveness of business critical processes to help safeguard and strengthen UBS?

We’re looking for a Risk Expert or Auditor to:

• plan, execute and lead audits, issue assurance, and risk assessment reviews according to our internal standards that are fully supported by the work done.
• highlight where controls are functioning well or where UBS needs to act to better manage current and emerging risks, and escalate any significant concerns or issues appropriately.
• meet our internal standards for the quality, execution and documentation of assurance work, taking account of legal entity coverage expectations, where required.
• proactively and successfully collaborate with peers in and across audit teams.
• build and maintain constructive relationships with colleagues and relevant stakeholders at all levels including senior management.
• continuously assess the risk profile of the relevant UBS IB businesses.
• participate in regulatory inspections and address inquiries from regulators

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented operations professional with strong accounting and reconciliation experience who can identify exceptions, research issues, and help maintain a high-quality experience for branch and business stakeholders by:

Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly.

Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

descriptionByLocale.en:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

title: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC

titleByLocale.en: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC
titleByLocale.it: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC
titleByLocale.de: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC
titleByLocale.fr: Global Wealth Management Marketing Strategist, APAC

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a Marketing Strategist to support the UBS Global Wealth Management (GWM) business across the APAC region. Working as part of the regional Market Coverage team, you will set a clear, data-informed direction for brand and marketing activation across APAC countries and segments, ensure alignment with divisional priorities, and orchestrate partnerships that amplify growth, reputation, and client impact.

Scope & Impact
• Work with the GWM regional marketing heads for Greater China, SEA/Japan and Australia and APAC Head of Marketing to shape the end-to-end Brand & Marketing planning process, integrating funnel goals and in-market priorities to deliver measurable outcomes.
• Partner with IB and AM Marketing coverage and Media and Communications teams to foster stronger cross-divisional coordination and One Bank brand and marketing initiatives
• Provide strategic guidance on value propositions, go-to-market strategies, key growth projects in partnership with the business and ensure narratives remain coherent and client-centric.
• Lead a team specialised in digital client acquisition marketing efforts, collaborating across functions, divisions and external partners to design and execute innovative campaigns that drive awareness, interest and engagement in new and existing audiences
• Work hand in hand with Marketing Excellence Labs (MELs), leveraging their expertise and insight for the benefit of the APAC region to deliver efficient and effective campaigns that grow existing clients and generate leads.
• Act as a senior marketing advisor with an increased focus on Australia as a new and valuable GWM book and where IB is already strong and Japan where the business across the Group is ambitious to grow further.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning
• Help define GWM’s multi-year marketing strategy and annual plan, including objectives by funnel stage and region, target-setting approach, and governance cadence.
• Translate strategic priorities into integrated campaign roadmaps, briefing requirements, and KPIs; ensure consistency between top-funnel brand goals and mid/bottom-funnel performance targets.
• Maintain a live portfolio view of programs, reallocating resources to the highest-impact opportunities amid constrained budgets and competitive noise.

Regional & Cross-Divisional Support
• Provide an objective APAC-wide perspective to avoid fragmented approaches and ensure cohesive regional strategy.
• Support a cross-divisional construct offering strategic advice and partnering with on-the-ground teams to deliver integrated outcomes. Seek out efficiencies by collaborating with IB, AM and P&C divisions to collectively achieve positive business and client outcomes.
• Bring to life regional on-the-ground knowledge of client behaviours and market dynamics for the benefit of all APAC country plans.

Briefing & Creative Excellence
• Co-create creative/media briefs that demand non-traditional ideas capable of breaking through clutter and driving earned amplification; steward agencies / internal teams to that quality bar.
• Ensure briefs specify funnel requirements by market and articulate how partners will support GWM to align targets and evaluation frameworks.

Measurement & Optimization
• Set and socialize measurement frameworks linking funnel progression to accelerate acquisition and business outcomes; run quarterly reviews to optimize mix, creative, and partnerships against target deltas.
• Champion test-and-learn performance marketing (new formats/channels, neuroscience or message testing) to continuously sharpen propositions and creative effectiveness.

title: Program Manager – House View Portfolio Management

titleByLocale.en: Program Manager – House View Portfolio Management
titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Programma – Gestione Portafoglio House View
titleByLocale.fr: Chef de Programme – Gestion de Portefeuille House View

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about building scalable investment capabilities and platforms that serve the most sophisticated clients? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where you can drive strategic initiatives from concept to execution? Are you a detail-oriented leader who can manage complexity while keeping the client experience at the center?

As a Product Manager in the Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions team, you will support the US House View Discretionary Models business through a blend of analytical, client-facing, and reporting work. You will have the opportunity to engage with capital markets, asset allocation, and content creation in a portfolio management environment. Your clear communication skills and attention to detail will be critical in this role.

• Product Manager and key stakeholder- serve as primary point of contact for questions and inquiries related to the Multi asset retail business. This role may include fielding inquiries from internal and external partners and resolving them appropriately. Support relationships with the various US retail advisor sales channels.
• Presentation materials - point person for maintenance and development of client presentations (pitch books, factsheets, investment reviews, etc.) and marketing materials. This role will have a focus on the maintenance of House View Portfolio Fact Sheets, the performance track record, and SharePoint site for all supporting materials. You will be expected to create and update content (presentation slides, commentary, etc.) that incorporates timely market events and help better position the Models with internal and external stakeholders. You will be partnering with portfolio managers and other product managers to develop and revise materials as appropriate.
• Represent the team in internal strategic initiatives, new product launches and projects. Translate strategic goals into actionable plans, manage key milestones, and deliver executive-level updates.
• Model portfolio subject matter expert- draft portfolio commentary and other Models’ communications, analyze model portfolios (returns, risk, performance attribution, etc.), business-related analysis and other ad hoc requests.
• Collaborate with Relationship Managers, Portfolio Advisory, and Product Specialists to ensure the House View platform meets client and advisor needs.
• Competitive Analysis - gather and analyze the competitive advantages of our industry peers and their competitive products.
• Automation - identify inefficiencies and manual processes that could benefit from automation using AI tools and leveraging internal partners to help drive strategic initiatives and grow the business.
• Manage technology-related workstreams, including vendor coordination, testing, and implementation of House View specific enhancements.
descriptionByLocale.it: Ti appassiona costruire capacità e piattaforme di investimento scalabili al servizio dei clienti più sofisticati? Cresci in un ambiente interfunzionale e frenetico in cui puoi guidare iniziative strategiche dall'ideazione all'esecuzione? Sei un leader attento ai dettagli in grado di gestire la complessità mantenendo al centro l'esperienza del cliente? In qualità di Product Manager nel team Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions, supporterai il business US House View Discretionary Models attraverso una combinazione di lavoro analitico, rivolto al cliente e di reporting. Avrai l'opportunità di interagire con i mercati dei capitali, l'allocazione degli asset e la creazione di contenuti in un ambiente di gestione del portafoglio. Le tue chiare capacità di comunicazione e l'attenzione ai dettagli saranno fondamentali in questo ruolo. • Product Manager e stakeholder chiave: fungono da punto di contatto primario per domande e richieste relative all'attività di vendita al dettaglio Multi asset. Questo ruolo può includere la risposta alle richieste di partner interni ed esterni e la loro risoluzione adeguata. Supportare i rapporti con i vari canali di vendita dei consulenti al dettaglio statunitensi. • Materiali di presentazione: persona di riferimento per la manutenzione e lo sviluppo delle presentazioni dei clienti (libri di presentazione, schede informative, revisioni degli investimenti, ecc.) e materiali di marketing. Questo ruolo si concentrerà sulla manutenzione delle schede informative del portfolio House View, sul track record delle prestazioni e sul sito SharePoint per tutti i materiali di supporto. Dovrai creare e aggiornare contenuti (diapositive di presentazione, commenti, ecc.) che incorporino eventi di mercato tempestivi e aiutino a posizionare meglio i Modelli presso le parti interessate interne ed esterne. Collaborerai con gestori di portafoglio e altri gestori di prodotto per sviluppare e rivedere i materiali in modo appropriato. • Rappresentare il team nelle iniziative strategiche interne, nel lancio di nuovi prodotti e nei progetti. Traduci gli obiettivi strategici in piani attuabili, gestisci i traguardi chiave e fornisci aggiornamenti a livello esecutivo. • Esperto in materia di portafoglio modello: redige commenti sul portafoglio e altre comunicazioni dei modelli, analizza portafogli modello (rendimenti, rischio, attribuzione delle prestazioni, ecc.), analisi relative al business e altre richieste ad hoc. • Collaborare con Relationship Manager, consulenti di portafoglio e specialisti di prodotto per garantire che la piattaforma House View soddisfi le esigenze dei clienti e dei consulenti. • Analisi competitiva: raccogli e analizza i vantaggi competitivi dei nostri colleghi del settore e dei loro prodotti competitivi. • Automazione: identificare le inefficienze e i processi manuali che potrebbero trarre vantaggio dall'automazione utilizzando strumenti di intelligenza artificiale e sfruttando i partner interni per guidare iniziative strategiche e far crescere il business. • Gestire i flussi di lavoro legati alla tecnologia, compreso il coordinamento dei fornitori, i test e l'implementazione di miglioramenti specifici di House View.
descriptionByLocale.de: Interessieren Sie sich für den Aufbau skalierbarer Investitionskapazitäten und -plattformen, die auch den anspruchsvollsten Kunden dienen? Gedeihen Sie in einem schnelllebigen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld, in dem Sie strategische Initiativen vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung vorantreiben können? Sind Sie eine detailorientierte Führungskraft, die Komplexität bewältigen kann und gleichzeitig das Kundenerlebnis im Mittelpunkt stellt? Als Produktmanager im Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions-Team unterstützen Sie das US House View Discretionary Models-Geschäft durch eine Mischung aus analytischer, kundenorientierter und Berichtsarbeit. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, sich in einer Portfoliomanagementumgebung mit Kapitalmärkten, Vermögensallokation und Inhaltserstellung auseinanderzusetzen. Ihre klaren Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Ihre Liebe zum Detail werden in dieser Rolle von entscheidender Bedeutung sein. • Produktmanager und wichtiger Stakeholder – fungieren als Hauptansprechpartner für Fragen und Anliegen im Zusammenhang mit dem Multi-Asset-Einzelhandelsgeschäft. Diese Rolle kann die Bearbeitung von Anfragen interner und externer Partner und deren angemessene Lösung umfassen. Unterstützen Sie die Beziehungen zu den verschiedenen Vertriebskanälen für Einzelhandelsberater in den USA. • Präsentationsmaterialien – Ansprechpartner für die Pflege und Entwicklung von Kundenpräsentationen (Pitchbooks, Factsheets, Investitionsberichte usw.) und Marketingmaterialien. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf der Pflege der House View Portfolio-Faktenblätter, der Leistungsbilanz und der SharePoint-Site für alle unterstützenden Materialien. Von Ihnen wird erwartet, dass Sie Inhalte (Präsentationsfolien, Kommentare usw.) erstellen und aktualisieren, die aktuelle Marktereignisse berücksichtigen und dazu beitragen, die Modelle bei internen und externen Stakeholdern besser zu positionieren. Sie arbeiten mit Portfoliomanagern und anderen Produktmanagern zusammen, um gegebenenfalls Materialien zu entwickeln und zu überarbeiten. • Repräsentieren Sie das Team bei internen strategischen Initiativen, neuen Produkteinführungen und Projekten. Übersetzen Sie strategische Ziele in umsetzbare Pläne, verwalten Sie wichtige Meilensteine ​​und stellen Sie Aktualisierungen auf Führungsebene bereit. • Fachexperte für Modellportfolios – Entwurf von Portfoliokommentaren und anderen Modellkommunikationen, Analyse von Modellportfolios (Renditen, Risiko, Leistungszuordnung usw.), geschäftsbezogene Analysen und andere Ad-hoc-Anfragen. • Arbeiten Sie mit Kundenbetreuern, Portfolioberatern und Produktspezialisten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die House View-Plattform die Bedürfnisse von Kunden und Beratern erfüllt. • Wettbewerbsanalyse – Sammeln und analysieren Sie die Wettbewerbsvorteile unserer Branchenkollegen und ihrer Wettbewerbsprodukte. • Automatisierung – Identifizieren Sie Ineffizienzen und manuelle Prozesse, die von der Automatisierung mithilfe von KI-Tools und der Nutzung interner Partner profitieren könnten, um strategische Initiativen voranzutreiben und das Geschäft auszubauen. • Verwalten Sie technologiebezogene Arbeitsabläufe, einschließlich Anbieterkoordination, Tests und Implementierung spezifischer Verbesserungen für House View.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Êtes-vous passionné par la création de capacités et de plateformes d'investissement évolutives qui servent les clients les plus sophistiqués ? Vous vous épanouissez dans un environnement interfonctionnel au rythme rapide où vous pouvez piloter des initiatives stratégiques de la conception à l’exécution ? Êtes-vous un leader soucieux du détail et capable de gérer la complexité tout en gardant l’expérience client au centre ? En tant que chef de produit au sein de l'équipe Stratégie de portefeuille de gestion de patrimoine et solutions multi-actifs, vous soutiendrez l'activité des modèles discrétionnaires de US House View grâce à une combinaison de travaux d'analyse, de contact client et de reporting. Vous aurez l'occasion de vous impliquer dans les marchés des capitaux, l'allocation d'actifs et la création de contenu dans un environnement de gestion de portefeuille. Vos compétences en communication claire et votre souci du détail seront essentiels dans ce rôle. • Chef de produit et partie prenante clé - servir de point de contact principal pour les questions et demandes de renseignements liées à l'activité de vente au détail multi-actifs. Ce rôle peut inclure de répondre aux demandes de renseignements des partenaires internes et externes et de les résoudre de manière appropriée. Soutenir les relations avec les différents canaux de vente des conseillers au détail aux États-Unis. • Supports de présentation - personne-ressource pour la maintenance et le développement des présentations clients (pitch books, fiches d'information, revues d'investissement, etc.) et des supports marketing. Ce rôle se concentrera sur la maintenance des fiches d'information du portefeuille House View, des antécédents de performance et du site SharePoint pour tous les documents de support. Vous devrez créer et mettre à jour du contenu (diapositives de présentation, commentaires, etc.) qui intègre les événements opportuns du marché et aidera à mieux positionner les modèles auprès des parties prenantes internes et externes. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des gestionnaires de portefeuille et d'autres chefs de produits pour développer et réviser les documents le cas échéant. • Représenter l'équipe dans les initiatives stratégiques internes, les lancements de nouveaux produits et les projets. Traduisez les objectifs stratégiques en plans d’action, gérez les étapes clés et fournissez des mises à jour au niveau de la direction. • Expert en la matière du portefeuille modèle : rédiger des commentaires sur le portefeuille et d'autres communications des modèles, analyser les portefeuilles modèles (rendements, risques, attribution de performance, etc.), des analyses liées à l'entreprise et d'autres demandes ponctuelles. • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de relations, les conseillers en portefeuille et les spécialistes de produits pour garantir que la plateforme House View répond aux besoins des clients et des conseillers. • Analyse concurrentielle – rassemblez et analysez les avantages concurrentiels de nos pairs du secteur et de leurs produits compétitifs. • Automatisation : identifiez les inefficacités et les processus manuels qui pourraient bénéficier de l'automatisation à l'aide d'outils d'IA et en tirant parti des partenaires internes pour vous aider à piloter des initiatives stratégiques et à développer l'entreprise. • Gérer les flux de travail liés à la technologie, y compris la coordination des fournisseurs, les tests et la mise en œuvre des améliorations spécifiques à House View.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Does quantitative modelling excite you? Are you experienced in credit risk?

We're looking for someone like you to:

• use techniques from quantitative risk management, financial mathematics, and econometrics to develop and maintain rating and LGD models used for Basel III Pillar 1 capital requirement and IFRS9 impairment losses
• be responsible for model maintenance and execution, ensuring alignment with stakeholders’ requirements and internal policies
• collaborate with Risk Officers, Business Managers, Risk IT and other stakeholders to support the proper implementation and execution of risk models as well as regulatory exercises
• present methodologies to management and regulators for approval
• contribute to the documentation of models, data, and system improvement
descriptionByLocale.it: La modellazione quantitativa ti entusiasma? Hai esperienza nel rischio creditizio? Cerchiamo qualcuno come te che: • utilizzi tecniche di gestione quantitativa del rischio, matematica finanziaria ed econometria per sviluppare e mantenere modelli di rating e LGD utilizzati per il requisito di capitale Pilastro 1 di Basilea III e le perdite per impairment secondo IFRS9 • essere responsabile della manutenzione e dell'esecuzione del modello, assicurando l'allineamento con i requisiti degli stakeholder e le politiche interne • collaborare con i responsabili del rischio, Business Manager, Risk IT e altri stakeholder per supportare la corretta implementazione e esecuzione dei modelli di rischio così come degli esercizi regolatori • presentare metodologie a management e regolatori per l'approvazione • contribuire alla documentazione di modelli, dati e miglioramento dei sistemi
descriptionByLocale.de: Begeistert Sie quantitative Modellierung? Haben Sie Erfahrung im Bereich Kreditrisiko? Wir suchen jemanden wie Sie, der: • Techniken aus dem quantitativen Risikomanagement, der Finanzmathematik und Ökonometrie anwendet, um Rating- und LGD-Modelle zu entwickeln und zu pflegen, die für Basel III Pillar 1 Kapitalanforderungen und IFRS9-Impairmentverluste verwendet werden, • für die Modellpflege und -umsetzung verantwortlich ist und die Übereinstimmung mit den Anforderungen und internen Richtlinien der Stakeholder sicherstellt • mit Risikoverantwortlichen zusammenarbeitet, Geschäftsleiter, Risiko-IT und andere Interessengruppen unterstützen die ordnungsgemäße Umsetzung und Umsetzung von Risikomodellen sowie regulatorische Übungen • präsentieren Methoden dem Management und den Regulierungsbehörden zur Genehmigung • tragen zur Dokumentation von Modellen, Daten und Systemverbesserungen bei
descriptionByLocale.fr: La modélisation quantitative vous enthousiasme-t-elle? Avez-vous de l'expérience en matière de risque de crédit? Nous recherchons quelqu'un comme vous pour : • utiliser des techniques de gestion quantitative des risques, mathématiques financières et économétrie afin de développer et maintenir les modèles de notation et de LGD utilisés pour les exigences de capital du Pilier 1 de Bâle III et les pertes par dégradation selon les IFRS9 • être responsable de la maintenance et de l'exécution du modèle, en veillant à l'alignement avec les exigences des parties prenantes et les politiques internes • collaborer avec les responsables des risques, Les responsables commerciaux, les responsables des risques et d'autres parties prenantes pour soutenir la bonne mise en œuvre et exécution des modèles de risques ainsi que des exercices réglementaires • présenter des méthodologies à la direction et aux régulateurs pour approbation • contribuer à la documentation des modèles, des données et de l'amélioration des systèmes

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a quantitative trader/developer with experience in building data-driven trading systems to join our fixed income algorithmic trading team within UBS Global Markets. This is a fast paced and collaborative team specialized in the development and management of best-in-class automated strategies in the fixed income space.
The role will be focused on government bonds and Interest Rate Swaps with opportunities to work on other asset class within the fixed income space.

• Sit within the Global Markets principal e-trading business and develop next generation algorithmic trading solutions.
• You will be involved in every aspect of algorithmic trading: designing, back testing, implementing trading strategies and as well tracking performance.
• Operate within a high-performing, fast paced quant development team, whose goals are directly aligned to the business
• You will employ analysis to help optimize systematic quoting and risk management strategies.

You should possess strong analytical skills and a passion for financial markets but also be experienced in object-oriented programming preferably in Java. Proven experience in a similar role is strongly preferred.

titleByLocale.fr: Analyste des rapports et de l'automatisation

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about data? Are you looking to drive key product and regulatory initiatives across banking products such as SBL, Mortgages, Cards and Deposits? We are looking for someone like that who will analyze product, Financial Advisor and client data, support product development, drive/support revenue-generating initiatives and work very closely with product management, control and support partners.
Key competencies and responsibilities include:

• Develop data-driven business insights and analytics to drive growth within Banking
• Key contributor to strategic initiatives and part of a team that works on business growth development initiatives
• Deliver insights and segmentation by leveraging various internal and external data to grow market share of banking products and services and support strategic banking decision making
• Use product/financial SME to demonstrate through reporting and analyses how the product area drives profitability and work to develop strategies to enhance revenues
• Develop and assist in various reporting initiatives and data analytics on banking initiatives
• Take an ownership role in product data capabilities and work within the team and with partners to ensure sound data governance and development frameworks
• Analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers
• Identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to construct recommendations for strategic/tactical sales plans
descriptionByLocale.it: Sei appassionato di dati? Stai cercando di guidare i prodotti chiave e le iniziative regolamentari attraverso i prodotti bancari come SBL, Mortgages, Carte e Depositi? Siamo alla ricerca di qualcuno come quello che analizzerà i dati del prodotto, del consulente finanziario e dei clienti, supporterà lo sviluppo del prodotto, le iniziative di generazione di ricavi del supporto e lavorerà molto a stretto contatto con i partner di gestione, controllo e supporto del prodotto. • Sviluppare intuizioni aziendali orientate ai dati e analisi per promuovere la crescita all'interno di Banking • Contribuente chiave per iniziative strategiche e parte di un team che lavora su iniziative di sviluppo della crescita aziendale • Fornire intuizioni e segmentazione sfruttando vari dati interni ed esterni per aumentare la quota di mercato dei prodotti bancari e dei servizi e sostenere iniziative strategiche di decisione bancaria • Utilizzare le PMI di sviluppo per dimostrare attraverso la reportistica e le strategie di sviluppo dei dati Assumere un ruolo di proprietà nelle capacità dei dati di prodotto e lavorare all'interno del team e con i partner per garantire un buon governance dei dati e dei framework di sviluppo • Analizzare complessi problemi aziendali e problemi utilizzando dati provenienti da fonti interne ed esterne per fornire informazioni ai decisori • Identificare e interpretare tendenze e modelli in dataset per costruire raccomandazioni per piani di vendita strategici/tattici
descriptionByLocale.de: Sie interessieren sich für Daten? Möchten Sie wichtige Produkt- und Regulierungsinitiativen für Bankprodukte wie SBL, Hypotheken, Karten und Einlagen vorantreiben? Wir suchen jemanden wie diesen, der Produkt-, Finanzberater- und Kundendaten analysiert, die Produktentwicklung unterstützt, umsatzgenerierende Initiativen vorantreibt und sehr eng mit Produktmanagement-, Kontroll- und Supportpartnern zusammenarbeitet. Zu den wichtigsten Kompetenzen und Verantwortlichkeiten gehören: • Entwicklung von datengesteuerten Business Insights und Analysen, um das Wachstum im Banking zu fördern • Wichtige Beiträge zu strategischen Initiativen und Teil eines Teams, das an Initiativen zur Unternehmenswachstumsentwicklung arbeitet • Bereitstellung von Erkenntnissen und Segmentierung durch die Nutzung verschiedener interner und externer Daten, um den Marktanteil von Bankprodukten und -dienstleistungen zu erhöhen und die strategische Entscheidungsfindung im Bankensektor zu unterstützen • Verwenden Sie Produkt- / Finanz-KMU, um durch Reporting und Analysen zu demonstrieren, wie der Produktbereich die Rentabilität antreibt und Strategien zur Umsatzsteigerung entwickelt • Entwicklung und Unterstützung bei verschiedenen Berichtsinitiativen und Datenanalysen zu Bankinitiativen • Übernehmen Sie eine Eigenverantwortung bei den Produktdatenfunktionen und arbeiten Sie im Team und mit Partnern, um eine solide Datenverwaltung und -entwicklung zu gewährleisten. Analysieren Sie komplexe Geschäftsprobleme und Probleme mithilfe von Daten aus internen und externen Quellen, um Entscheidungsträgern Einblick zu geben • Identifizieren und interpretieren Sie Trends und Muster in Datensätzen, um Empfehlungen für strategische / taktische Verkaufspläne zu erstellen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Êtes-vous passionné par les données? Souhaitez-vous piloter des initiatives clés en matière de produits et de réglementation pour les produits bancaires tels que les SBL, les prêts hypothécaires, les cartes et les dépôts ? Nous recherchons une personne comme celle-là qui analysera les données des produits, des conseillers financiers et des clients, soutiendra le développement de produits, pilotera/soutenira les initiatives génératrices de revenus et travaillera en très étroite collaboration avec les partenaires de gestion, de contrôle et de support des produits. Les principales compétences et responsabilités comprennent : Développer des informations et des analyses commerciales basées sur les données pour stimuler la croissance au sein du secteur bancaire. Contributeur clé aux initiatives stratégiques et membre d'une équipe qui travaille sur les initiatives de développement de la croissance de l'entreprise. Fournir des informations et une segmentation en exploitant diverses données internes et externes pour accroître la part de marché des produits et services bancaires et soutenir la prise de décision bancaire stratégique. Utiliser les PME de produits/financières pour démontrer, par le biais de rapports et d'analyses, comment le domaine de produits stimule la rentabilité et travailler à développer des stratégies pour améliorer les revenus. Développer et aider à diverses initiatives de reporting et d'analyse de données sur les initiatives bancaires. • Assumer un rôle de propriétaire dans les capacités de données sur les produits et travailler au sein de l'équipe et avec des partenaires pour garantir une gouvernance des données et des cadres de développement solides. • Analyser des problèmes et des problèmes commerciaux complexes en utilisant des données provenant de sources internes et externes pour fournir un aperçu aux décideurs. • Identifier et interpréter les tendances et les modèles dans les ensembles de données pour élaborer des recommandations pour les plans de vente stratégiques/tactiques.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you an enthusiastic technology professional, interested in state-of-the-art frameworks, tools and techniques? Are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs?
At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.
We’re looking for a Software Engineer with Linux experience. You will be required to:
• be responsible for designing and building critical components to successfully deliver solutions
• work with a global team of analysts, engineers and business stakeholders
• be overall responsible for creating impactful change to our clients through the delivery of our products while ensuring the high quality and compliance of the product with risk and security policies
• take ownership and drive software deliveries
• embrace complex business requirements and enjoy the challenge of implementing them
• provide engineering and analytical skills
• identify opportunities to improve our processes
• mentor junior team members
• contribute widely in establishing and promoting best practices and pro-actively investigate new technologies
• be able to perform code reviews across our team and enforce Enterprise Application design and architectural standards
work in an agile team, with a hybrid working model

descriptionByLocale.en:
An Investment Associate provides support to the wealth management team in the analysis and marketing of products and services, alongside client service.

- Perform investment research and analysis on investment solutions and products for the FAs.
- Manage the implementation of investment solutions with FA oversight.
- Listen to quarterly update calls for investment providers and provide a summary to the team.
- Ensure all time-sensitive work and supporting documentation is completed in a timely manner
- Provide written summaries on investment analysis and outlook for existing and prospective managers
- Prepare supporting materials and sample reports that can be used in client and potential client meetings
- Collaborate with Operations and Home Office to ensure issues are quickly and effectively resolved
- Undertake administrative services to support the team
- Analyze product groups specific to individual clients circumstance and perform analysis

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Are you great with numbers?
Do you enjoy analysing financial information and understanding how the numbers tell a story?
Are you tech‑savvy and curious to learn how finance works in a global organisation?

We’re looking for an intern to join our Finance team who will support day‑to‑day accounting and reporting activities and gain hands‑on experience in a corporate finance environment.

In this role, you will:
• Support accounting and financial activities within the Finance function
• Prepare and deliver financial reports such as Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, close packs, and other management reports in an accurate and timely manner
• Analyse and investigate variances, ensuring required adjustments are accurately reflected in the general ledger
• Perform reconciliations and analyse financial data to support financial reporting and controls
• Collaborate with colleagues and contribute to improving the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of financial processes and internal controls
• Gain exposure to financial reporting processes in a global organization and develop practical finance and analytical skills

Do you enjoy analysing financial information and understanding how the numbers tell a story?
Are you tech‑savvy and curious to learn how finance works in a global organisation?

We’re looking for an intern to join our Finance team who will support day‑to‑day accounting and reporting activities and gain hands‑on experience in a corporate finance environment.

In this role, you will:
• Support accounting and financial activities within the Finance function
• Prepare and deliver financial reports such as Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, close packs, and other management reports in an accurate and timely manner
• Analyse and investigate variances, ensuring required adjustments are accurately reflected in the general ledger
• Perform reconciliations and analyse financial data to support financial reporting and controls
• Collaborate with colleagues and contribute to improving the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of financial processes and internal controls
• Gain exposure to financial reporting processes in a global organization and develop practical finance and analytical skills

descriptionByLocale.it: UBS Business Solutions US LLC è alla ricerca di un direttore, trader di opzioni FX a New York, NY Sei un pensatore innovativo? Ti piace offrire funzionalità di cambiamento avanzate in una vasta gamma di funzioni aziendali? Sei appassionato di automazione dei processi IT utilizzando piattaforme di strumenti all'avanguardia? Stiamo cercando un Direttore, Trader di opzioni FX per: • Fornire market making e gestione del rischio per tutte le coppie di valute dei mercati emergenti di opzioni su cambi (FX) al franchise di clienti UBS utilizzando conoscenze specializzate di strumenti e sistemi sviluppati internamente, tra cui Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas e Brokertron. • Concentrarsi su un campo di conoscenza specializzato nelle valute dei mercati emergenti delle opzioni FX per mantenere superfici di volatilità accurate su tutte le coppie di valute considerando i flussi dei clienti e le operazioni sul mercato interbancario. Gestire i rischi del flusso dei clienti e le posizioni di inventario. • Sfruttare la conoscenza avanzata di Market Maker Gui e Bloomberg per produrre idee commerciali regolari e aggiornamenti di mercato, costruire e gestire relazioni con clienti e potenziali clienti. Partecipare a iniziative di opzioni FX per aumentare la presenza di UBS nel mercato statunitense con particolare attenzione all'America Latina e collaborare con i team di vendita e strategia all'interno dei mercati globali per sfruttare le opportunità di opzioni FX negli Stati Uniti. • Applicare la conoscenza approfondita delle conoscenze specialistiche dei nostri strumenti sviluppati internamente, tra cui T-Pricer e Market Maker Gui, per migliorare l'offerta di trading elettronico di UBS ai nostri clienti statunitensi tramite profili di prezzo personalizzati e tecnologia avanzata nelle coppie di valute dei mercati emergenti di opzioni FX. • Supportare la divisione Trading di opzioni FX per gestire in modo efficiente ed efficace le operazioni commerciali, mantenendo la responsabilità per oltre 50 superfici di volatilità delle opzioni FX. I candidati qualificati possono presentare domanda tramite SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Fare riferimento a 001684. NESSUNA CHIAMATA PER FAVORE. Gamma di retribuzioni e programma di lavoro EOE/M/F/D/V: da $ 225.000 a $ 275.000 / anno, 40 ore / settimana. Il presente avviso viene pubblicato in relazione a una richiesta di certificazione permanente del lavoro straniero. Chiunque può commentare o fornire prove documentali relative alla presente domanda a: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labour Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210. Gli intervalli di retribuzione previsti per questo ruolo alla data di questo annuncio si basano su fattori tra cui, ma non limitati a, esperienza, qualifiche, istruzione, posizione e livello di competenza. Questo ruolo può anche avere diritto a un compenso incentivante discrezionale. Per informazioni sui vantaggi, visita ubs.com/usbenefits.
descriptionByLocale.en:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking a Director, FX Options Trader in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for a Director, FX Options Trader to:
• Provide market-making and risk management for all Foreign Exchange (FX) Options emerging market currency pairs to the UBS client franchise utilizing specialized knowledge of internally developed tools and systems, including Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas and Brokertron.
• Focus on specialized field of knowledge in FX Options emerging markets currency to maintain accurate volatility surfaces across all the currency pairs by considering client flows and interbank market trades. Manage client flow risks and inventory positions.
• Leverage advanced knowledge of Market Maker Gui and Bloomberg to produce regular trade ideas and market updates, build and manage relationships with clients and prospective clients. Engage in FX Options initiatives to increase the UBS footprint in the U.S. market with a focus on Latin America, and partner with Sales and Strategy teams within Global Markets to capitalize on FX Options opportunities within the U.S.
• Apply expert understanding of specialized knowledge of our internally developed tools including T-Pricer and Market Maker Gui to improve the UBS E-trading offering to our U.S. clients via customized pricing profiles and enhanced technology in FX Options emerging markets currency pairs.
• Support the FX Options Trading division to efficiently and effectively run business operations, while maintaining responsibility for over 50 FX Options volatility surfaces.

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001684. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary Range & Work Schedule: $225,000 to $275,000 /year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.
descriptionByLocale.de: UBS Business Solutions US LLC sucht einen Director, FX Options Trader in New York, NY. Sind Sie ein innovativer Denker? Gefällt es Ihnen, erweiterte Änderungsmöglichkeiten für eine Reihe von Geschäftsfunktionen bereitzustellen? Interessieren Sie sich für die Automatisierung von IT-Prozessen mithilfe modernster Tooling-Plattformen? Wir suchen einen Director, FX Options Trader, der: • Market-Making und Risikomanagement für alle Währungspaare von Devisenoptionen (FX) in Schwellenländern für das UBS-Kundengeschäft bereitstellt und dabei Fachkenntnisse über intern entwickelte Tools und Systeme nutzt, darunter Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas und Brokertron. • Konzentrieren Sie sich auf ein spezielles Wissensgebiet im Bereich Devisenoptionen in Schwellenländerwährungen, um genaue Volatilitätsoberflächen über alle Währungspaare hinweg aufrechtzuerhalten, indem Sie Kundenströme und Interbankenmarktgeschäfte berücksichtigen. Verwalten Sie Kundenflussrisiken und Lagerbestände. • Nutzen Sie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über Market Maker Gui und Bloomberg, um regelmäßige Handelsideen und Marktaktualisierungen zu erstellen sowie Beziehungen zu Kunden und potenziellen Kunden aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Beteiligen Sie sich an FX-Options-Initiativen, um die Präsenz von UBS auf dem US-Markt mit Schwerpunkt auf Lateinamerika zu vergrößern, und arbeiten Sie mit Vertriebs- und Strategieteams innerhalb der globalen Märkte zusammen, um von FX-Options-Chancen in den USA zu profitieren. • Wenden Sie Expertenwissen über das Spezialwissen unserer intern entwickelten Tools an, einschließlich T-Pricer und Market Maker Gui, um das E-Trading-Angebot von UBS für unsere US-Kunden durch maßgeschneiderte Preisprofile und verbesserte Technologie in FX Options-Währungspaaren für Schwellenländer zu verbessern. • Unterstützen Sie die FX-Optionshandelsabteilung bei der effizienten und effektiven Führung des Geschäftsbetriebs und behalten Sie gleichzeitig die Verantwortung für über 50 Volatilitätsoberflächen für FX-Optionen. Qualifizierte Bewerber bewerben sich über SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Bitte geben Sie 001684 an. BITTE KEINE ANRUFE. EOE/M/W/D/V Gehaltsspanne und Arbeitsplan: 225.000 bis 275.000 $/Jahr, 40 Std./Woche. Diese Bekanntmachung wird im Zusammenhang mit einem Antrag auf eine dauerhafte Ausländerarbeitsbescheinigung veröffentlicht. Jede Person kann Kommentare abgeben oder dokumentarische Nachweise im Zusammenhang mit dieser Bewerbung vorlegen an: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labour Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210. Die erwartete(n) Gehaltsspanne(n) für diese Rolle zum Zeitpunkt dieser Veröffentlichung basiert/basieren auf Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf, Erfahrung, Qualifikationen, Ausbildung, Standort und Qualifikationsniveau. Diese Rolle kann auch Anspruch auf eine diskretionäre Anreizvergütung haben. Informationen zu den Vorteilen finden Sie unter ubs.com/usbenefits.
descriptionByLocale.fr: UBS Business Solutions US LLC recherche un directeur, négociateur d'options FX à New York, NY Êtes-vous un penseur innovant ? Aimez-vous offrir des capacités de changement améliorées dans une gamme de fonctions commerciales ? Êtes-vous passionné par l’automatisation des processus informatiques à l’aide de plateformes d’outils de pointe ? Nous recherchons un directeur, Trader d'options FX pour : • Assurer la tenue de marché et la gestion des risques pour toutes les paires de devises des marchés émergents d'options de change (FX) à la franchise client UBS en utilisant une connaissance spécialisée des outils et systèmes développés en interne, notamment Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas et Brokertron. • Se concentrer sur un domaine spécialisé de connaissances dans les devises des marchés émergents d'options de change pour maintenir des surfaces de volatilité précises sur toutes les paires de devises en tenant compte des flux de clients et des transactions sur le marché interbancaire. Gérer les risques de flux clients et les positions de stocks. • Tirer parti des connaissances avancées de Market Maker Gui et Bloomberg pour produire régulièrement des idées commerciales et des mises à jour du marché, établir et gérer des relations avec les clients actuels et potentiels. Participer aux initiatives d'options de change visant à accroître l'empreinte d'UBS sur le marché américain en mettant l'accent sur l'Amérique latine, et collaborer avec les équipes de vente et de stratégie des marchés mondiaux pour capitaliser sur les opportunités d'options de change aux États-Unis. • Appliquer une compréhension experte de nos connaissances spécialisées de nos outils développés en interne, notamment T-Pricer et Market Maker Gui, pour améliorer l'offre de trading électronique d'UBS à nos clients américains via des profils de tarification personnalisés et une technologie améliorée dans les paires de devises des marchés émergents d'options de change. • Soutenir la division FX Options Trading pour gérer efficacement les opérations commerciales, tout en restant responsable de plus de 50 surfaces de volatilité des options FX. Les candidats qualifiés postulent via SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Veuillez référencer le 001684. AUCUN APPEL S'IL VOUS PLAÎT. EOE/M/F/D/V Échelle salariale et horaire de travail : 225 000 $ à 275 000 $/an, 40 heures/semaine. Cet avis est publié dans le cadre d'une demande de certification permanente de travail étranger. Toute personne peut commenter ou fournir des preuves documentaires concernant cette candidature à : Département américain du Travail, de l'Emploi et de la Formation, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210. L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste à la date de cette offre est basée sur des facteurs comprenant, mais sans s'y limiter, l'expérience, les qualifications, l'éducation, l'emplacement et le niveau de compétence. Ce rôle peut également être éligible à une rémunération incitative discrétionnaire. Pour plus d’informations sur les avantages, veuillez visiter ubs.com/usbenefits.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking a Director, Product Owner, in Morrisville, NC Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms? We’re looking for a Director, Product Owner to:
• Define and maintain the AI (Artificial Intelligence) product roadmap for Wealth Management America, leveraging machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics while maintaining strong partnership and collaboration with key stakeholders.
• Triage with business stakeholders, data scientists, and engineers to gather and translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for AI solutions. Oversee the design, development, and deployment of ML models, recommendation engines, and intelligent automation solutions, ensuring accuracy, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
• Functionally manage product backlog, prioritize features, create user stories, and coordinate Agile/Scrum sprints to deliver AI-driven enhancements efficiently. Monitor AI solution performance, define success metrics, evaluate predictive accuracy, and recommend improvements to optimize business outcomes.
• Ensure AI products comply with financial regulations, internal policies, data privacy standards, and ethical AI guidelines, including bias detection and mitigation. Stay current on AI/ML technologies, fintech innovations, and market trends to inform product strategy and maintain competitive advantage in wealth management.

• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience
• support client advisors in administrative, risk and legal and compliance related tasks and duties
• manage daily business in WM HNW/UHNW client servicing and provide high quality service

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you currently transitioning from the US Armed Services and seeking a training assignment in the Financial Services Industry?
UBS is seeking individuals like you to participate in our SkillBridge training program. Only transitioning services members approved for DOD SkillBridge will be considered

Do you want to keep criminals from abusing the financial system? Are you someone who likes to do the right thing? Do you know how to maintain independence and objectivity? We are looking for someone like that who can:

• review client transactions, conduct initial analysis and identify suspicious activity as well as escalate cases for further review
• research entities and/or individuals using both public domain and database search services
• maintain regular contact with branch personnel to obtain necessary information about customers and account activity
• help with the design and development of monitoring reports and assist management with testing enhancements to the monitoring program
• supports senior staff in researching and responding to regulatory requests
• sponsorship for Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist / Certified AML and Fraud Professional considered for those transitioning to full time employment

Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques
