descriptionByLocale.en:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain sophisticated decision-making system at scale. Develop and support large scale real-time trading risk monitoring system to support multi-asset risk management within global markets.
• Build out scenario analytical platform to support risk management of portfolios and client margin management. Build scalable solutions to identify opportunities for prime brokerage, Delta 1 trading, inventory management, funding, lending and collateral optimization.
• Engage and understand balance sheet and risk requirements and/or controls. Lead technology design discussions for scalability and performance.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001520. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary Range & Work Schedule: $170,000 to $225,000 /year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about operational risk and keen to understand how an Investment Bank manages it? Are you self-motivated, driven, and able to lead workstreams to meet deadlines? Do you have the confidence to constructively challenge processes and provide innovative solutions?

We’re looking for someone who can support the Investment Bank in its first-line control and operational risk management activities, specifically to:

• •support delivery of the first line non financial risk and supervisory framework across AMER Global Banking
• •act as a point of contact for risk, supervision and control matters, providing pragmatic, business aligned advice
• •oversee key non financial risk processes, including RCSAs, conflicts of interest and inducements registers, non financial risk events and issues, and remediation tracking
• •review and challenge risk and supervisory MI, escalating material issues and employee conduct incidents as appropriate
• •responsibility to lead local regulatory and audit exams, representing GB BRM
• •build strong relationships with Global Banking senior management and control partners, and present at relevant governance forums

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you thrive in fast-paced, front-office environments where execution and collaboration drive results? Are you passionate about scaling businesses, improving efficiency, and enabling revenue growth?

We’re seeking a Business Manager to join the Unified Global Markets (UGM) COO team, supporting senior leadership across Sales and Trading to deliver strategic initiatives that enhance business performance and client outcomes. In this role, you’ll work side-by-side with front-office team members to streamline processes, scale the platform, and drive commercial momentum across asset classes.

You’ll act as a trusted partner to senior business heads – connecting strategic objectives with day-to-day execution, and helping shape how UGM grows and competes across the Americas

• •partner with members of the COO team and senior business leaders to execute strategic priorities that support growth, efficiency, and scalability across Sales and Trading
• •identify and drive front-to-back process improvements to enhance productivity, client responsiveness, and execution quality
• •support commercial initiatives to optimize the client experience, improve sales coverage models, and unlock new revenue opportunities
• •deliver data-driven insights to help leadership measure performance and make informed decisions
• •lead or coordinate cross-functional projects across Trading, Sales, COO, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams
• •anticipate business needs and proactively design solutions that improve speed to-market, platform scalability, and front-office efficiency
• •maintain awareness of operational and regulatory frameworks, ensuring strategic execution remains sound and sustainable

• Promote consistency in validation practices
• Guide and mentor junior validators.‎
• Drive internal initiatives

Are you a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities and a passion for driving complex M&A transactions? Do you combine rigorous financial analysis with the ability to deliver clear insights to senior stakeholders?

• support and selectively lead strategic M&A initiatives across UBS Group

Are you an analytical thinker with outstanding attention to detail, sound judgement and a relentless work ethic? Do you excel in demanding environments and enjoy translating complex financial and strategic questions into clear, persuasive materials for clients, investors and senior stakeholders?

•identify key issues early, assess alternatives with sound judgement and help drive practical, well-reasoned solutions under tight timelines

descriptionByLocale.en:
Would you like to make an impact on our Group’s sustainability governance and controls? Are you passionate about sustainability and ESG topics?
We’re looking for a Sustainability Controller like you to:
• enhance the governance framework over our Group's sustainability disclosures and reporting. This includes defining the governance process, timelines and documentation and control standards for metric owners and disclosure owners, as well as challenging and approving proposed metrics to ensure disclosures are fit for purpose
• act as a SME on various sustainability reporting topics. Be our point of contact for multiple stakeholders on matters relating to metrics, disclosures, and reporting. Coordinate with data providers to educate, enhance, and embed the control framework for sustainability reporting
• use your deep accounting and sustainability reporting knowledge to perform content and analytical reviews of our Group sustainability disclosures. Assess reporting revisions and impacts on reporting.
• support assurance activities over sustainability reporting. Act as an interface between auditors and internal stakeholders
• define, conduct and review metric reporting risk assessments
• integrate new ESG regulatory requirements and/or standards into business as usual.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role
Do you enjoy working in a tax environment where accuracy and compliance matter? As a Tax Specialist, you will support VAT- and real-estate-tax-related compliance activities for Real Estate DACH, ensure high-quality data and documentation, and help deliver reconciliations, analyses and controls. In this role, you will support day-to-day tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements in the tax environment.

We’re looking for a Tax Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• support quarterly fair value updates, including changes in use, input VAT adjustments and subsidies
• review and validate property allocation ratios
• prepare quarterly VAT returns; review documentation and file supporting documents to ensure timely submission
• perform annual turnover reconciliations and support VAT analyses and audits
• support preparation of real estate capital gains tax statements
• support real estate tax processes
• support direct tax and administrative tasks (e.g., supporting documents, data preparation)
• support continuous improvement of VAT processes and controls

• contribute to process improvements and automation in the reporting and control environment

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you interested in working in the fastest growing area of passive investments?
Are you highly motivated by financial markets and portfolio construction?
Do you enjoy working in a high performing, diverse and international team?
Do you have a flair for numbers and presenting to stakeholders and clients? Then this is the role for you!

UBS Asset Management is seeking an Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs to join the ETF & Index Fund business which is one of the key growth areas of the company.
Index tracking investment solutions have been a core competence of UBS Asset Management for over 30 years.

Key tasks:
• monthly Analytics deliverables which requires running reports,
• maintaining and updating collateral material,
• performing in-depth analysis on products and competitor offerings,
• clearly articulate and present the findings of the analysis to internal,
• strong MS Office skills, in particular Excel and PowerPoint,
• programming skills, with R coding skills being highly advantageous,
• motivated to enhance and automate processes involving data and displaying results in reports and presentations,
• having a positive attitude and willingness to learn and contribute to a high-performance team.

You will be supporting the ETF & Index Fund Investment Analytics team

UBS has a long track record of specialising in a quality indexing approach, which has contributed to them being one of the fastest growing index managers globally. Assets under management across index strategies amount to more than USD 1tn and USD 170bn in ETFs (as at Q4 25).

descriptionByLocale.en:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Cyber Security Risk Assessments Specialist in Nashville, TN
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Cyber Security Risk Assessments Specialist to:
• Perform high-quality and high-integrity Cyber and Information Security technical risk assessments, root cause analysis and risk investigations on IT and Cloud architectures, infrastructures, platforms, applications, technology stacks and business projects, based on current cyber threats landscape and emerging risks.
• Perform deep dives and thematic reviews into bank’s Cyber and Information Security capabilities and services, drawing conclusions on the overall risk posture of a specific security vertical.
• Proactively and constructively challenge the status quo identifying Cyber and Information Security operational risks, proposing realistic remediation or improvement solutions while understanding potential tradeoffs and minimizing risks.
• Technical partner in Cyber and Information Security for senior stakeholders in a highly federated environment, being the advocate of the security risk culture.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001682. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary & Work Schedule: $126,000/year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role

Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for an Operations Specialist who will be responsible for end-to-end processing of paper and electronic check items cleared through the Federal Reserve, including posting adjustments, researching discrepancies, and processing Fed returns. This role ensures timely, accurate settlement and strict compliance with Federal Reserve, Reg CC, and internal bank policies.

Key Responsibilities:
• Investigate and resolve client inquiries related to payment issues, including sanctions holds, returned funds, and payment cancellations.
• Monitor and manage payment queues, ensuring timely resolution of flagged or delayed transactions.
• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Compliance, Operations, Risk) to resolve complex cases and escalate issues when necessary.
• Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.

titleByLocale.en: Mutual Fund Core Processing Specialist - US Shift
titleByLocale.it: Mutual Fund Core Processing Specialista - US Shift

titleByLocale.fr: Mutual Fund Core Processing Spécialiste - US Shift

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for someone like that who can

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Mutual Fund Core Specialist to join our operations team. This role is responsible for all operational aspects of mutual fund processing while supporting key functions that ensure accuracy and timeliness in trade execution. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset to work across internal teams and external parties.

Key 
• Responsibilities:

Trade Execution & Processing

Assist in entering mutual fund trades into internal systems with precision and speed.

Confirm trade eligibility based on fund rules, account setup, and compliance guidelines.

Monitor trade activity throughout the day to ensure timely execution and settlement.

Support wire entry and ensure proper routing of funds to meet trade settlement deadlines.

Reconciliation & Issue Resolution

Reconcile mutual fund positions and transactions daily at both the CUSIP and account level.

Identify and resolve breaks or discrepancies in trade data, escalating issues when needed.

Collaborate with internal teams (operations, technology, compliance) to troubleshoot and resolve trade-related issues.

Communication & Collaboration

Interact with fund companies, custodians, and counterparties to clarify trade details and resolve exceptions.

Maintain clear and professional communication across departments to support smooth trade processing.

Support audits, internal controls, and process improvement initiatives related to reconciliation and transfer processes.

Document procedures and contribute to training materials for both onshore and offshore teams.

Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to:

• Develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for building out our digital platform solutions
• Define and maintain Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) aligned to product and business strategy
• Collaborate with end users in IB Operations to communicate art of the possible and identify business processes that require transformation and migration onto new platforms
• Assess potential use cases objectively and understand business value vs cost of solution, looking to reuse or extend existing capabilities where feasible
• Influence the design of new solutions to deliver benefit for multiple stakeholders where possible
• Maintain pod and iteration backlogs in Gitlab to a high standard
• Assist with relevant data sourcing, ensuring compliance with the firms policies
• Obtain necessary governance approvals for new use cases / solutions
• Mitigate impediments to the team’s goals, align across pods and with other crews where needed and act as your pod’s ambassadors towards internal stakeholders and clients

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about the financial markets? Are you an innovator who loves to solve problems? We are looking for someone to use their expertise and join UBS Valuation Control Group in Mumbai

• responsible to review & perform the independent price testing (ipv) of fair valued assets & liabilities in the rates and fx ; products include bonds, swaps, swaptions, bermudans, fx options etc.
• computation & reporting of reserves for the rates and fx business
• discuss & agree with desk, finance and valuation methodology teams on product valuation, month end ipv adjustments & reserve numbers
• review & perform prudential valuation calculation for the fair valued positions in the rates business
• review of monthly valuation packs along with commentaries explaining the reserves & ipv numbers
• on a continuous basis review/challenge client needs and prepare reports in standardized format, with adhoc reports and analysis for senior management
• represent the team during internal & external audits, running the auditors through the different processes in detail & resolving their queries

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a professional, degree-educated Executive Assistant with at least five years’ experience supporting at C-suite / senior level within the international financial industry to support the Country Head of Italy.

The role would suit someone who looks to thrive and add value whilst working in a demanding, diverse, fast-paced and high-profile international environment. The ability to multi-task, prioritise, exercise sound judgement and discretion is key to the success of this role.

Core Responsibilities:

• ensuring the smooth, seamless management of the Country Head of Italy’s office, working autonomously and in collaboration with the Head and his Chief of Staff. Gatekeeping both in person and over the phone.
• advanced, proactive diary management, facilitating swift set-up of all client meetings both internal and external, whilst applying good judgment and an understanding of competing priorities.
• meetings, conference calls, web conferences set-up and moderating – internally and externally.
• professional client handling and relationship building with all clients, bankers and committee groups.
• email and man management (where applicable). There will be a need for the successful candidate to manage the inbox daily and alert the Head to that which needs his attention.
• effective travel planning and management; production of accurate itineraries; plans A to Z; able to navigate systems well and apply good judgment on how to optimise the Country Head’s time.
• a small amount of personal admin will also be required.

titleByLocale.de: SAP S/4 Hana Finanzen Functional SME

descriptionByLocale.en:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Functional Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

title: Market risk model validation Quantitative Analyst

titleByLocale.en: Market risk model validation Quantitative Analyst
titleByLocale.it: Market risk model validation Quantitative Analista
titleByLocale.de: Market risk model validation Quantitative Analyst
titleByLocale.fr: Market risk model validation Quantitative Analyste

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a Market risk quant in the Market risk model validation team in India to perform:
• Independent validation of market risk models in line with the UBS model governance policy and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities include
• Assess the model's conceptual soundness and methodology
• Check the appropriateness/quality of input data used for model development, review appropriateness of model parameters, accuracy of the model calibration etc.
• Review model outcome, impacts, or develop alternate benchmark approaches to challenge model outputs (as appropriate)
• Assess model risk, providing effective challenge to model assumptions and evaluate model limitations
• Write comprehensive validation reports, documenting the assessments to required standards
• Collaborate effectively with stakeholders globally to understand / challenge potential model risks; communicate validation findings to relevant stakeholders
• Support ongoing review of model performance and model change reviews to ensure models remain fit for purpose

descriptionByLocale.en:
Ensure Completeness, Accuracy and Timeliness ("CAT") requirements Trade capture controls and Trade Lifecycle controls for our investment banking derivatives trades across credit business. This includes daily exceptions management of intersystem reconciliations at transaction/position/cash level, also the associated reporting activities, and ensuring appropriate escalation of items work with other TLCS (Trade & Lifecycle Controlling Services) stakeholders..

Are you inquisitive with analytical and risk-aware mindset? Do you have a F2B controls background?

We’re looking for a Middle Office Specialist to:

• •Be responsible for a suite of controls, facilitating support aimed at mitigating risk and working with other MO functions to resolve escalated issues
• •monitor and run the CSAs for SPEs as these are not managed through the bank’s collateral pool
• •Run controls on collateral and cash sitting in an SPE – Daily check in respect of any changes made to the collateral held in UBS’s SPVs
• •Actively and continually provide ideas and execute on process improvements in the exception management and data quality of submission to clients.
• •Be the subject matter expert in all team activities and support teams and peripheral stakeholders.
•Project Management activities – assisting with end-to-end support around IMO initiatives including conducting initial impact analysis, tracking for deliverables and following up with management and IMO staff.
• •Take ownership of tracking, updating issue and action logs
• •Partner with sales and trading to manage and facilitate new business initiatives
• •Participate in strategic change initiatives by acting as subject matter expert

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a student or recent graduate looking to gain practical experience at a globally recognized financial institution?
Are you interested in marketing and eager to learn more about content marketing, content production, and publishing processes?
Do you bring strong German language skills and enjoy working with content and details?
If so, join our team for a 6-12 month internship with an expected availability of 24 hours per week.
In this role, you will support the Content Marketing & Client Communication team with:
• Coordinating translation and publishing processes
• Preparing content for distribution across online and offline channels
• Updating and maintaining SharePoint websites
• Performing quality checks on editorial content
• Maintaining and updating editorial calendars
• Monitoring news and regulatory updates relevant to banking and finance
• Brainstorming new content ideas and contributing to creative team discussions

This internship offers hands-on experience in content marketing, exposure to real publishing processes, and an excellent foundation for a future career in marketing, communications, or digital roles within an international environment.

descriptionByLocale.en:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Authorized Officer, Quant Services Consultant in Weehawken, NJ.

Are you an innovative thinker? Are you focused on the details, even when under pressure? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions?

We’re looking for an Authorized Officer, Quant Services Consultant to:
• Contribute to the development, implementation and validation of quantitative models. Drive quantitative projects for all business divisions and group functions.
• Perform statistical data analysis including regression models and time series analyses to transform real-world data into meaningful results for the bank. Review the appropriateness of input data, model assumptions, parameters, and calibration accuracy as well as qualitative or expert adjustments.
• Drive transformation and change across the firm. Actively increase the capabilities and performance of the team, to meet business needs. Communicate effectively with all audiences in a structured manner and collaborate with diverse teams to reach the best solution.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001445. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V. #LI-DNI

Salary & Work Schedule: $112,778 to $125,000 Per Year, 40 hrs/wk. The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

title: Canada IB Chief Compliance and AML Officer

titleByLocale.en: Canada IB Chief Compliance and AML Officer
titleByLocale.it: Canada IB Chief Compliance and AML Officer
titleByLocale.de: Canada IB Chief Compliance and AML Officer
titleByLocale.fr: Canada IB Chief Compliance and AML Officer

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you interested in developing and driving solutions that advance UBS’s strategic objectives? Do you execute with excellence? Are you entrepreneurial, proactive, and forward looking?
As the Chief Compliance Officer and Chief Anti Money Laundering Officer, you will oversee and lead the Compliance function for UBS Securities Canada Inc. and perform the following:
• partner with legal counsel to ensure that policies, guidelines, standards and Compliance monitoring and testing procedures and business procedures are consistent with local regulatory requirements and interpretations of laws, regulations, rules or any other related industry regulatory standards or guidelines
• liaise with senior management as well as functional leaders in compliance, legal, risk, and IT to provide subject-matter expertise on existing, new, or updated laws, rules, and regulations as well as effective challenge, guidance, and advice
• participate in relevant Committees as well as various other global, regional, and cross-product committees
• draft and publish policies and procedures and maintain a local compliance training program
• participate and provide support in regulatory exams and inquiries
• complete Compliance Risk Assessments and thematic reviews to assess emerging risk themes
• running the IB Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function for the Canadian IB Legal entities (working with FCP team members in Canada in the United States, and globally as applicable).
• acting as the local Money Laundering Reporting Officer / Chief AML Officer for the IB Canadian Entities – key duties will be: (i) Local Board Reporting on FCP Matters; (ii) contributing to the FCP Global Risk Assessment (which involves completing local Canadian Questionnaires annually); (iii) Owning and overseeing any local IB Canada specific compliance and AML/KYC policies, procedures and protocols (as well as any KPC attestations that relate to these local policies, procedures, protocols) to ensure they meet current regulatory expectations and are aligned with enterprise-wide standards.
• being the focal point for any GIA / Regulatory compliance exams (inclusive of AML / FCP exams) and interacting with provincial and federal regulators, including regulatory filings as applicable.
• implementing the IB FCP Framework of UBS' global IB Division, and ensuring compliance, operational and FCP risks are identified, properly assessed and managed.
• provide strategic direction and oversight to the IB / stakeholders in relation to IB FCP deliverables and initiatives (taking into account applicable : (i) legislation, (ii) rules and guidance, (iii) industry best practice).

• Producing detailed MIs for AML TM Management,
• Assessing and identifying key AML risks and process gaps.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Sales Assistant to support the Senior Relationship Management team and ARC team within our Investment Banking platform. This individual will play a critical role in enabling front-office productivity by managing complex schedules, coordinating logistics, and ensuring seamless execution of day-to-day sales and client activities.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates a strong sense of urgency, and brings a proactive, team-first mindset. This role requires excellent organizational skills, the ability to multitask effectively, and confidence handling time-sensitive requests and ad hoc projects.

Key Responsibilities
• Manage and coordinate complex, multi-party calendars for senior relationship managers, including internal and external client meetings
• Serve as a central point of coordination for sales desk activity, ensuring efficient communication across teams
• Support sales teams in servicing institutional clients by handling inquiries, tracking follow-ups, and maintaining high service standards
• Prepare and maintain client-facing materials such as pitchbooks, presentations, market updates, and product summaries
• Coordinate client meetings and internal forums, including logistics and materials preparation
• Manage travel planning (domestic and international) and ensure timely submission of T&E expenses in compliance with internal policies
• Help maintain CRM systems and client databases
• Handle ad hoc projects for senior leadership, demonstrating proactive problem-solving and sound judgment

titleByLocale.en: Credit Risk Analyst - IB Hedge Funds Americas
titleByLocale.de: Credit Risk Analyst - IB Hedge Funds Americas

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have sharp analytical skills? We’re looking for someone who can:
• assess counterparty credit risk using an understanding of hedge fund and family office risk management, trading strategies, infrastructure, and other quantitative and qualitative credit factors, including onsite due diligence visits
• use delegated authority, within defined risk limits, to approve new positions or recommend decisions to senior credit committees, partnering closely with the business to ensure transactions align with UBS’s risk appetite
• evaluate transactional risk across OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange-traded derivatives, banking products, and structured transactions
• prepare, review, and approve annual counterparty reviews and transactional credit proposals, clearly articulating credit assessments, risk appetite, exposure drivers, and business outlook
• lead negotiation of trading documentation, including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage, and Repo Agreements
• manage regulatory requests, audit items, and operational risk issues in a timely and disciplined way
• deliver ad hoc credit analysis and contribute to portfolio reviews to identify emerging risks and concentrations

descriptionByLocale.it:
WMCH UBS CH AG : Accountant (EE) Are you great with numbers? Do you have attentions to the details? We're looking for someone like that who can help us: In providing high quality accounting, reporting and analytical services to our Zurich based internal clients in EMEA Time Zone from Pune BSC, including:
• Preparation of complex accounting Journals, ledger integrity checks and control, account ownership sign off in BCS reconciliation, feed reconciliation, clearance of suspense balance
• Preparation and presentation of MoM/QoQ variance analysis with quality commentary and business drivers insight for senior management and diverse stakeholders
• Preparation and presentation of management accounts and variance analysis
• Detailed analysis and exception reporting for various feeds reported into Primary ledger from Accounting and system architecture perspective
• Preparation and consolidation of Divisional Notes to accounts for Fair Value, Off Balance sheet and various other topic post co-ordination across various LE controllers.
• Supporting various change the bank projects initiatives from respective accounts and disclosure owned by respective team member
• Co-ordination of all legal entity activity, with key internal experts such as tax, regional, group controlling, auditor etc.
• Strong hands on experience in ARP and advance MS-Excel skills required to generate and report various data analytics. The role requires team collaboration skills in addition to being an individual contributor. Re-engineering and standardization of processes as required and support business specific initiatives. Also to have the flexibility required to work in a dynamic environment under tight deadlines

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand? Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done? We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia. In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond. You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.
• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about data engineering? Are you keen to manage data that can materially help teams improve the way they work? You have the opportunity to join the team working on the new DevLens initiative, an ambitious data initiative to help our 40,000 IT employees organization accelerate value delivery to customers, improve organization efficiency and developer experience. Together with your team you will contribute to building and maintaining innovative data products spanning all engineering activities across UBS IT lines of business. You will work with large delta tables on Azure Databricks with Dagster, AKS, PySpark & SparkSQL, Confluent Kafka, REST APIs, database platforms, serving data products on Starburst/Trino data mesh. We’re looking for a passionate Data Engineer to:
• Develop, support and improve data pipelines and data products with attention to governance including sourcing, lineage, modelling, security, quality, distribution and efficiency
• Automate testing & deployment where possible using CI/CD pipelines
• Build observability to monitor and resolve production issues
• Analyse and organize raw data and be able to combine multiple datasets of varying quality
• Take ownership and drive deliveries within a supportive team environment
• Follow engineering best practices, and ensure bank & regulatory compliance across the lifecycle
• Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions, promote re-use where possible.
• Help manage the department data inventory and data products
• Provide data support to internal & external stakeholders
• Be comfortable within a geographically spread, fast-moving Agile team
• Continuously up-skill, learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

• Analyse and organize raw data and be able to combine multiple datasets of varying quality
• Take ownership and drive deliveries within a supportive team environment
• Follow engineering best practices, and ensure bank & regulatory compliance across the lifecycle
• Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions, promote re-use where possible.
• Help manage the department data inventory and data products
• Provide data support to internal & external stakeholders
• Be comfortable within a geographically spread, fast-moving Agile team
• Continuously up-skill, learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Financial Services INC cerca un amministratore delegato, UGM OTC Equity Solutions a New York, NY Sei un pensatore innovativo? Ti piace fornire funzionalità di cambiamento migliorate in una gamma di funzioni aziendali? Sai come coinvolgere diversi tipi di persone su una varietà di argomenti? Stiamo cercando un amministratore delegato, UGM OTC Equity Solutions per:
• Progettare nuovi prodotti finanziari derivati dall'equità, utilizzando swap, mettere opzioni, opzioni di chiamata, opzioni asiatiche a lungo dipendente e esotici. Struttura dei prodotti finanziari con una sofisticata comprensione delle tecniche analitiche quantitative e matematiche fondamentali, compreso il calcolo, il prezzo e il commercio.
• Sviluppare modelli utilizzando gli strumenti analitici e matematici ottenuti attraverso il lavoro in matematica. Analizzare le superfici di volatilità del singolo stock, le superfici di volatilità del mercato, gli ambienti dei tassi di interesse a livello globale e i tassi di cambio stranieri a livello globale.
• Modifiche prevedibili dell’economia della strategia dal punto di vista del cliente e dalla prospettiva dell’UBS in base ai cambiamenti della volatilità delle scorte, dei tassi di interesse, dei tassi di cambio e alla correlazione dei tre. Assistere i professionisti non-quantitativi a comprendere pienamente tutti i rischi e i potenziali risultati delle strategie basate su cambiamenti e aspettative in questi mercati.
• Interpretare gli obiettivi del cliente in prodotti azionari, derivati azionari per produrre risultati economici desiderabili per il cliente e parametri di rischio UBS accettabili Design prodotti azionari manipolando i dati per produrre vari risultati. Interpretare i risultati e modificare i driver di valore per produrre i risultati desiderati.
• Scrivere interfacce user-friendly per i modelli di prezzi derivati azionari costruiti, che a loro volta sono utilizzati da altri membri del team per la determinazione dei prezzi e dei rischi da utilizzare per presentare soluzioni a varie parti internamente per l'approvazione, e per le presentazioni dei clienti. Adapt caratteristiche del prodotto, modelli e materiali di marketing per nuovi cambiamenti nella progettazione del prodotto, e progetta formule matematiche sull'implementazione del prodotto e della strategia. UBS Financial Services INC is seeking a Managing Director, UGM OTC Equity Solutions in New York, NY Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Do you know how to engage different kinds of people on a variety of topics? We’re looking for a Managing Director, UGM OTC Equity Solutions to:
• Design new equity derivative financial products, using swaps, put options, call options, path-dependent Asian options, and exotics. Structure financial products with a sophisticated understanding of fundamental quantitative and mathematic analytical techniques, including calculus, to price and trade.
• Develop models using the analytical and mathematical tools gained through work in mathematics. Analyze single stock volatility surfaces, market volatility surfaces, interest rate environments globally, and foreign exchange rates globally.
• Predict changes in the strategy’s economics from the client’s perspective and the UBS’s perspective based on changes in stock volatility, interest rates, exchange rates, and the correlation of the three. Assist non-quantitative professionals to fully understand all the risks and potential outcomes of strategies based on changes and expectations in these markets.
• Interpret client goals into equity products, equity derivatives to produce desirable economic outcomes for the client and acceptable UBS risk parameters Design equity products by manipulating the data to produce various results. Interpret results and changes value drivers to produce desired results.
• Write user-friendly interfaces for the equity derivative pricing models built, which in turn are used by other team members for pricing and risk determination for use in presenting solutions to various parties internally for approval, and for client presentations. Adapt product features, models, and marketing materials for new changes in product design, and designs mathematical formulas on product and strategy implementation. Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 000461. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V Salary Range & Work Schedule: $350,000 to $500,000 /year, 40 hrs/wk. title: Senior Strategist, Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services

titleByLocale.en: Senior Strategist, Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services
titleByLocale.it: Senior Strategist, Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services
titleByLocale.de: Senior Strategist, Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Strategist, Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you looking for role guiding families of exceptional financial success on matters related to doing good with wealth for loved ones and the communities they care about? Reporting to the Head of Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services, U.S., you’ll operate within the UHNW coverage and advisory model as an extension of the Financial Advisor team. You’ll support clients across the full lifecycle, from early liquidity and succession planning through ongoing multigenerational stewardship.
You’ll be deployed selectively where family complexity, scale, and opportunity require deeper engagement, and where early involvement can shape long term outcomes for both clients and UBS.
You’ll also work as part of the global Social Impact & Philanthropy team, collaborating across regions and with colleagues in sustainability, impact investing, and social finance to build and scale solutions that advance the impact economy.

As a Senior Strategist you will:
• partner with Financial Advisors to identify opportunities for family advisory and philanthropy conversations and engage spouses, rising generations, and future decision makers early
• design and lead client engagements across governance, decision making, succession, leadership transition, next generation development, and family culture
• translate discovery discussions into practical outputs such as governance recommendations, decision frameworks, succession roadmaps, family meeting agendas, multigenerational engagement plans, and philanthropy strategies
• maintain momentum after meetings by clarifying decisions, ownership, and next steps, helping families move from intent to action
• increase adoption of the UBS Optimus Foundation as a platform for high-impact philanthropy where relevant
• act as a thought leader through client events and content
• track and report advisor and client activity in line with UHNW Advisory requirements, helping expand advisory scope, retention, and wallet share
• contribute to the ongoing development of Social Impact & Philanthropy offerings
• connect teams and capabilities across UBS

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment?
As a Client Onboarding Specialist, you will support Global Banking by executing the client onboarding process for clients involved in capital markets and corporate financing transactions. This includes completing the required Know Your Customer (KYC), regulatory, and tax onboarding requirements, and working with clients and internal stakeholders to gather, review, and validate the necessary information. Your work ensures clients are fully onboarded into our platform ahead of deal execution, and that all AML and regulatory obligations are satisfied in a timely and compliant manner.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
• Owning the end-to-end request intake process – monitoring the shared inbox, triaging new onboarding requests, and conducting open-source research on clients and transactions to determine onboarding requirements
• Conducting initial outreach to client counsel and internal business stakeholders to gather required documentation and information
• Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client and transaction records in the case workflow tool to ensure full pipeline visibility and organized case tracking
• Coordinating with client counsel and internal Global Banking deal teams throughout the onboarding lifecycle to obtain outstanding documentation and drive cases to completion
• Keeping cases current in the workflow tool as they progress, reflecting changes to deal timelines, outreach status, and case stage to support accurate reporting and team awareness
• Proactively communicating with deal teams to align on transaction scope or timeline changes, providing clear and timely onboarding progress updates
• Performing screening on clients and related parties, reviewing adverse media, and escalating matters to Financial Crime Prevention when required
• Preparing complete onboarding files, addressing feedback from the Quality Assurance team, and ensuring all documentation and data capture meet internal standards
• Acting as a single point of contact for the deal teams to ensure the client onboarding process is completed ahead of transaction timelines

Are you great with numbers? Do you enjoy analysing financial information and understanding how the numbers tell a story? Are you tech‑savvy and curious to learn how finance works in a global organisation? We’re looking for an intern to join our Finance team who will support day‑to‑day accounting and reporting activities and gain hands‑on experience in a corporate finance environment. In this role, you will:
• Support accounting and financial activities within the Finance function
• Prepare and deliver financial reports such as Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, close packs, and other management reports in an accurate and timely manner
• Analyse and investigate variances, ensuring required adjustments are accurately reflected in the general ledger
• Perform reconciliations and analyse financial data to support financial reporting and controls
• Collaborate with colleagues and contribute to improving the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of financial processes and internal controls
• Gain exposure to financial reporting processes in a global organization and develop practical finance and analytical skills

Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi iniziare la tua carriera in un'azienda che incoraggia l'apprendimento e la crescita professionale? Come parte della vostra squadra, sarete
• • Progettazione, sviluppo e miglioramento dei prodotti digitali e dei servizi tecnologici che forniamo ai nostri clienti e dipendenti.
• • Applicare una vasta gamma di pratiche di ingegneria del software, dall'analisi delle esigenze degli utenti e dallo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità al test e alla distribuzione automatizzati.
• Assicurare la qualità, la sicurezza, l'affidabilità e la conformità delle nostre soluzioni applicando i nostri principi digitali e implementando requisiti funzionali e non funzionali.
• •Ottenere l'osservanza delle nostre soluzioni, monitorare la salute della produzione, aiutare a risolvere gli incidenti e rimediare alla causa principale di rischi e problemi.
• Sostenere, rappresentare e sostenere le esigenze del cliente. •Condividi conoscenze e competenze con i colleghi e contribuisci regolarmente alla nostra cultura ingegneristica e alle comunità interne. Programma di laurea in tecnologia
• Potrai partecipare al nostro programma globale di laurea Tech, immersivo, progettato per accelerare il tuo sviluppo come ingegnere software. Il programma offre:
• Supporta l'esperienza dal primo giorno su piattaforme reali e critiche.
• Esporre tecnologie all'avanguardia tra cui cloud, container e sistemi distribuiti.
• Sviluppo professionale attraverso l'apprendimento strutturato, le certificazioni e le comunità ingegneristiche.
• Guida di ingegneri e architetti esperti che guideranno e supporteranno la vostra crescita.
• Un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale dove si impara dai pari di tutte le regioni.
• • Avanzamento del cliente attraverso un programma completo di 18 mesi a partire dall'agosto 2026, che vi crea per il successo a lungo termine presso UBS.
descriptionByLocale.en: Looking to start your career in a company that encourages learning and professional growth? As a part of your team, you will •Design, develop, and improve the digital products and technology services we provide to our clients and employees. •Apply a broad range of software engineering practices, from analyzing user needs and developing new features to automated testing and deployment. •Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non-functional requirements. •Build observability into our solutions, monitor production health, help to resolve incidents, and remediate the root cause of risks and issues. •Understand, represent, and advocate for client needs. •Share knowledge and expertise with colleagues and contribute regularly to our engineering culture and internal communities. Tech Graduate Program You will participate in our immersive global Tech Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development as a software engineer. The program offers: •Hands on experience from day one on real, business critical platforms. •Exposure to cutting edge technologies including cloud, containers, and distributed systems. •Professional development through structured learning, certifications, and engineering communities. •Guidance from experienced engineers and architects who will mentor and support your growth. •A collaborative, international environment where you learn from peers across regions. •Career advancement through an 18 month comprehensive program starting in August 2026, setting you up for long term success at UBS.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Möchten Sie Ihre Karriere in einem Unternehmen beginnen, das Lernen und berufliches Wachstum fördert? Als Teil Ihres Teams werden Sie
• Design, Entwicklung und Verbesserung der digitalen Produkte und Technologiedienstleistungen, die wir unseren Kunden und Mitarbeitern anbieten.
• Wenden Sie eine breite Palette von Software-Engineering-Praktiken an, von der Analyse der Benutzeranforderungen und der Entwicklung neuer Funktionen bis hin zu automatisiertem Testen und Deployment.
• Gewährleistung der Qualität, Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Konformität unserer Lösungen durch Anwendung unserer digitalen Prinzipien und Umsetzung sowohl funktionaler als auch nicht-funktionaler Anforderungen.
• Integrieren Sie die Beobachtbarkeit unserer Lösungen, überwachen Sie den Zustand der Produktion, helfen Sie bei der Lösung von Vorfällen und beheben Sie die Ursache von Risiken und Problemen.
• Verstehen, vertreten und befürworten Sie die Bedürfnisse der Kunden.
• Teilen Sie Wissen und Fachwissen mit Kollegen und tragen Sie regelmäßig zu unserer Ingenieurskultur und internen Gemeinschaften bei. Tech Graduate Programm
• Sie werden an unserem immersiven globalen Tech Graduate Program teilnehmen, das Ihre Entwicklung als Software-Ingenieur beschleunigen soll. Das Programm bietet:
• Hands on Erfahrung vom ersten Tag an auf echten, geschäftskritischen Plattformen.
• Exposition gegenüber modernsten Technologien, einschließlich Cloud, Containern und verteilten Systemen.
• Professionelle Entwicklung durch strukturiertes Lernen, Zertifizierungen und Ingenieurgemeinschaften.
• • Anleitung von erfahrenen Ingenieuren und Architekten, die Ihr Wachstum betreuen und unterstützen.
• Ein kollaboratives, internationales Umfeld, in dem Sie von Gleichaltrigen in allen Regionen lernen.
• Karrierefortschritt durch ein 18-monatiges umfassendes Programm ab August 2026, das Sie auf langfristigen Erfolg bei UBS vorbereitet.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

• Conception, développement et amélioration des produits numériques et des services technologiques que nous fournissons à nos clients et collaborateurs.

• Comprendre, représenter et défendre les besoins des clients.
• Partager les connaissances et l'expertise avec nos collègues et contribuer régulièrement à notre culture d'ingénierie et à nos communautés internes. Programme d'études supérieures en technologie
• Vous participerez à notre programme mondial immersif d'études supérieures en technologie, conçu pour accélérer votre développement en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel. Le programme offre:
• L'expérience du premier jour sur les plates-formes réelles et critiques pour les entreprises.
• •Exposer les technologies de pointe, y compris le cloud, les conteneurs et les systèmes distribués.
• Développement professionnel par l'apprentissage structuré, les certifications et les communautés d'ingénieurs.
• • Conseils d'ingénieurs et d'architectes expérimentés qui vous accompagneront et vous accompagneront dans votre croissance.
• Un environnement collaboratif et international où vous apprendrez des pairs de différentes régions.
• L'avancement de carrière par un programme complet de 18 mois à partir d'août 2026, vous mettant en place pour le succès à long terme à UBS.

titleByLocale.it: Branch Ops Manager, UBS Wealth Consulenza Center
titleByLocale.en: Branch Ops Manager, UBS Wealth Advice Center
titleByLocale.de: Branch Ops Manager, UBS Wealth Advice Center
titleByLocale.fr: Branch Ops Manager, UBS Wealth Advice Center

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a confident decision maker and problem solver? Do you lead by example? Do you enjoy problem solving and have the ability to influence people around you in positive and professional way? We’re looking for someone like you that can:
• Serve as the Operations Manager of the Wealth Advice Center, an office consisting of 200,000+ clients, 400+ Financial Advisors and Team Associates
• Ensure that the review of all daily Operational items including client money movement, trades, new account approvals, and client correspondence are completed in a timely and efficient manner
• Manage the Wealth Advice Center Assistant Operations Managers, Branch Service Associates, and KYC Team
• Partner with our Supervisory team to ensure the Operations Team, Client Service Associate Teams, and Financial Advisors are in compliance with all firm policies and procedures
• Train and develop new Operations team members as they join the Wealth Advice Center platform
• Identify and escalate the resolution of urgent client services issues
• Drive and execute various business initiatives that are in line with the WAC’s growth plan
• Promote a culture of ongoing learning & development
• Implement service excellence standards, including coaching and educating operational Support Staff on the UBS Client Experience

title: Tech Graduate Program – Technology Risk Specialist

titleByLocale.it: Tech Graduate Program – Technology Risk Specialista
titleByLocale.en: Tech Graduate Program – Technology Risk Specialist
titleByLocale.de: Tech Graduate Program – Technology Risk Spezialist
titleByLocale.fr: Tech Graduate Program – Technology Risk Spécialiste

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you curious about how large global organizations manage technology risk at scale? Do you enjoy analysing complex problems and turning data into actionable insight? Are you eager to start your career in a team that safeguards the bank’s stability through modern risk management practices? If this sounds interesting take your next career step with UBS! As a part of your team, you will:
• Analyze technology risk data, reports and metrics to identify patterns, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk dashboards, reporting, and governance materials.
• Support automation, tooling enhancements, and AI adoption initiatives impacting technology risk.
• Work with stakeholders to incorporate risk and control requirements into application development backlogs.
• Assist in assessing control effectiveness and evaluating adherence to UBS policies and guidelines. Tech Graduate Program You will be participating in our immersive global graduate program. Not only will you connect with peers worldwide, it will offer you: Hands-on Experience: Gain exposure to a variety of tech projects from day one. Cutting-Edge Technologies: Stay updated with the latest tech. Professional Development: Enhance your technical skills through training and understand our business. Guidance from experts: Receive insights, advice, and support from our experienced professionals. Environment: Collaborate, learn, and exchange ideas across organization. Career Advancement: 18 months comprehensive Tech Graduate Program kicks off in August 2026, ensuring your growth and success at UBS.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Do you want to work on high profile strategic transactions with leading Consumer & Retail clients?
• Are you analytical, detail oriented, and eager to develop strong technical and commercial skills?
• Are you motivated by a high intensity, high reward environment where you can make an impact from day one?
• We’re looking for an Analyst who can help us to:
• – Make a difference for our clients and colleagues through creative thinking, hard work and dedication
• – Support the execution of M&A, ECM and financing transactions through rigorous analysis, modelling, and process coordination
• – Prepare high quality client materials, including pitchbooks, sector updates, valuation analyses, and transaction documentation
• – Make sound and balanced judgments and challenge the status quo (and always within professional, ethical, regulatory, and legal standards)
• – Motivate and inspire others by providing a vision of shared goals
• – Contribute to our positive culture and initiatives

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Java Developer in Morrisville, NC Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms? We’re looking for an Associate Director, Java Developer to:
• Design, code, conduct code reviews, and testing software as needed. Develop code, implement client, server and web-based applications, web services and unit testing. Lead participation in application architecture and design and other phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and implement a robust set of web services and APIs to power web applications.
• Development of various application components. Implemented all the front-end components using Spring MVC. Lead the technical design of application components in concert with CTO, DISO (Divisional Information Security Office) & team leads.
• Drive and ensure code quality, monitoring & Observability, UT and SIT testing guidelines and procedures are met. Lead the adoption of Innovative technologies (like Open AI) to boost developer and QA productivity. Triage with global development teams and business stakeholders to ensure project timelines are met.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote). Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001623. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V Salary & Work Schedule: $145,000/year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210. The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you interested in real estate asset management? Are you an expert in quality management and do you have strong analytical skills? Would you like to use your skill set and knowledge to support our local product teams in Switzerland, responsible for managing the real estate investment products in the DACH region? We’re looking for a quality management specialist to support the real estate investment teams in their daily tasks such as:
• maintenance, modification, and quality assurance of master data, including ongoing validation of monthly data imports provided by external property management companies
• performance of data analyses and KPI monitoring to ensure data accuracy
• preparation, review, and coordination of regular and ad-hoc reports for real estate asset managers in Switzerland
• initiation, coordination and monitoring of operational processes for the Asset Management department
• administration and support of external marketing mandates
• further development and maintenance of the central, CRM-based tenant and concept database, including AI-supported data validation and automated quality checks
• coordination of tenant credit checks and operator risk monitoring, including preliminary analyses to identify patterns and potential early risk indicators
• execution and coordination of Know-Your-Clients (KYC) and third-party checks in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
• support of audit-relevant quality controls, ensuring compliance with documentation, retention, and archiving guidelines
• active participation in real estate asset management projects and collaboration with external partner

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have an analytic mindset? Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of risk management and control at a large international investment and wealth management bank? Do you have a keen eye for detail and a curiosity for understanding how models and artificial intelligence (AI) systems align with regulatory standards and industry best practice? • •Develop an understanding of policies and procedures by shadowing initiatives related to regulatory requirements and industry standards
• •Build skills in creating clear and impactful presentations by observing and contributing to the preparation of reporting materials

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione
• Stiamo cercando un strutturatore di svolgere un ruolo all'interno del nostro team Fixed Income Structuring, con una particolare attenzione ai tassi e mercati FX. Il ruolo combina l'origine del prodotto, l'impegno del cliente, la strutturazione avanzata e i prezzi. Mansioni - Structuring, pricing, esecuzione e documentazione di complesse transazioni a reddito fisso in OTC e formati di note strutturate - Originare idee commerciali e soluzioni client, lavorare a stretto contatto con le vendite per impegnarsi direttamente con i clienti, capire i loro obiettivi e fornire risultati su misura - Progettare, modellare e pagare i prezzi su FX e sui prodotti di tassi, tra cui analisi degli scenari, test di stress e gestione del rischio del ciclo di vita - Fornire competenze sulla documentazione, tra cui ISDA, annessi di credito e documentazione di nota strutturata, coordinando con legale, operazioni e rischio per garantire una esecuzione robusta
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a structurer to play a role within our Fixed Income Structuring team, with a particular focus on rates and FX markets. The role combines product origination, client engagement, advanced structuring, and pricing. Key responsibilities include:
• Structuring, pricing, execution, and documentation of complex fixed income transactions across OTC and structured note formats
• Originate trade ideas and client solutions, working closely with sales to engage directly with clients, understand their objectives, and deliver tailored outcomes
• Design, model, and price bespoke payoffs across FX and rates products, including scenario analysis, stress testing, and lifecycle risk management
• Provide expertise on documentation, including ISDA, credit annexes, and structured note documentation, coordinating with legal, operations, and risk to ensure robust execution
descriptionByLocale.de: Descrizion Wir suchen einen Strukturierer, der eine Rolle in unserem Fixed-Income-Strukturierungsteam spielt, mit besonderem Fokus auf Zinssätzen und Devisenmärkten. Die Rolle kombiniert Produktherstellung, Kundenbindung, fortgeschrittene Strukturierung und Preisgestaltung. Mansioni Strukturierung, Preisgestaltung, Ausführung und Dokumentation komplexer festverzinslicher Transaktionen in OTC- und strukturierten Notizformaten - Originieren Sie Handelsideen und Kundenlösungen, arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Vertrieb zusammen, um direkt mit Kunden in Kontakt zu treten, ihre Ziele zu verstehen und maßgeschneiderte Ergebnisse zu liefern Design, Modell und Preis maßgeschneiderte Auszahlungen über FX und Preise Produkte, einschließlich Szenarioanalyse, Stresstests und Lifecycle-Risikomanagement - Bereitstellung von Fachwissen zu Dokumentation, einschließlich ISDA, Kreditanhängen und strukturierter Notizdokumentation, Koordination mit Recht, Betrieb und Risiko, um eine robuste Ausführung zu gewährleisten
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Nous recherchons un structurateur pour jouer un rôle au sein de notre équipe de Structuring à revenu fixe, en mettant l'accent sur les taux et les marchés FX. Le rôle combine l'origine du produit, l'engagement des clients, la structuration avancée et le prix. Mansioni - Structuration, tarification, exécution et documentation d'opérations complexes à revenu fixe selon les formats OTC et structurés - Inspirer des idées commerciales et des solutions client, travailler en étroite collaboration avec les ventes pour dialoguer directement avec les clients, comprendre leurs objectifs et obtenir des résultats adaptés - Conception, modèle et prix sur mesure pour les produits FX et les tarifs, y compris l'analyse des scénarios, les tests de stress et la gestion des risques du cycle de vie - Fournir des connaissances spécialisées en matière de documentation, y compris l ' ISDA, les annexes relatives au crédit et la documentation structurée des notes, en coordination avec les services juridiques, les opérations et les risques afin d ' assurer une exécution rigoureuse

• Stiamo cercando qualcuno come quello che può: - fornire funzionalità di trading elettronico ai nostri clienti FX attraverso le nostre piattaforme single-dealer, API, piattaforme multi-dealer e soluzioni di fornitori in tutto il ciclo commerciale (pre-trade, esecuzione e post-trade) - superare gli obiettivi di vendita per la nuova acquisizione del cliente e la crescita del volume con adeguato up-sell e cross-sell - on-board, mantenere e sviluppare nuove relazioni con i clienti in più segmenti di client, tra cui (ma non esclusivo a) banche, fondi di copertura, soldi reali e broker - fornire feedback client al team di sviluppo del prodotto per migliorare efficacemente l'esperienza del cliente in tutti i nostri e-Channels - gestire e influenzare direttamente la priorità di sviluppo e valorizzazione del prodotto - consegnare il nostro franchise in classi di asset
descriptionByLocale.en: Are you a target driven individual? Are you skilled at translating data into factual information and able to have strategic conversations? Are you passionate about the digitalisation of banking and want to be a part of a growing electronic sales team? We’re looking for someone like that who can: · deliver electronic trading capabilities to our FX clients through our single-dealer platforms, APIs, Multi-dealer platforms, and vendor solutions across the whole trade cycle (pre-trade, execution, and post-trade) · exceed sales targets for new client acquisition and volume growth with appropriate up-sell and cross-sell · on-board, maintain and develop new client relationships in multiple client segments including (but not exclusive to) Banks, Hedge Funds, Real Money and brokers · provide client feedback to the product development team to effectively enhance the client experience across all our e-Channels · manage and directly impact the prioritization of product development and enhancements · deliver our franchise across asset classes
descriptionByLocale.de: Descrizion Sind Sie ein zielgerichtetes Individuum? Sind Sie in der Lage, Daten in sachliche Informationen zu übersetzen und strategische Gespräche zu führen? Sie interessieren sich für die Digitalisierung des Bankings und möchten Teil eines wachsenden elektronischen Verkaufsteams sein? Wir suchen jemanden wie diesen, der kann: - Bereitstellung elektronischer Handelsfunktionen für unsere FX-Kunden über unsere Single-Dealer-Plattformen, APIs, Multi-Dealer-Plattformen und Anbieterlösungen über den gesamten Handelszyklus (Pre-Trade, Ausführung und Post-Trade) - Umsatzziele für Neukundenakquise und Volumenwachstum mit angemessenem Up-Selling und Cross-Selling übertreffen - On-Board, Pflege und Entwicklung neuer Kundenbeziehungen in mehreren Kundensegmenten, einschließlich (aber nicht ausschließlich) Banken, Hedgefonds, Real Money und Broker Kundenfeedback an das Produktentwicklungsteam, um die Kundenerfahrung in allen unseren E-Channels effektiv zu verbessern - Verwalten und direkte Auswirkungen auf die Priorisierung der Produktentwicklung und -verbesserungen - Liefern Sie unser Franchise in allen Anlageklassen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Êtes-vous une personne ciblée? Êtes-vous capable de traduire les données en informations factuelles et d'avoir des conversations stratégiques? Êtes-vous passionné par la numérisation de la banque et voulez-vous faire partie d'une équipe de vente électronique en croissance? Nous cherchons quelqu'un comme ça qui peut : - fournir des capacités de trading électronique à nos clients FX par l'intermédiaire de nos plates-formes mono-commerçants, API, plateformes multi-commerçants, et des solutions de fournisseurs tout au long du cycle commercial (pré-commerce, exécution et post-commerce) - dépasser les objectifs de vente pour l'acquisition de nouveaux clients et la croissance du volume avec une mise à niveau et une vente croisée appropriées - à bord, maintenir et développer de nouvelles relations avec les clients dans plusieurs segments de clients, y compris (mais pas exclusivement) les banques, les fonds spéculatifs, l'argent réel et les courtiers - fournir la rétroaction du client à l'équipe de développement de produits pour améliorer efficacement l'expérience du client dans tous nos canaux électroniques - gérer et avoir une incidence directe sur la hiérarchisation du développement et des améliorations des produits - offrir notre franchise à travers les classes d'actifs

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about transforming data into a true asset that drives innovation and growth? Do you have the expertise and vision to help shape the future of data management for a leading global asset manager? If so, we want you to join our Chief Data Office (CDO) team as a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst. We at UBS Asset Management believe that data is not just information – it’s one of our most valuable assets. Our mission is to establish data as a value driver and enabler of strategic innovation across the firm. We are seeking a driven, forward-thinking individual who can help us build the next generation of data platforms and unlock the potential of AI and GenAI for the future. Your role: As a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building and managing the data foundation of UBS Asset Management, working at the intersection of data, technology, and business.
• Your responsibilities will include: - Managing the Roadmap: Define and prioritize the product roadmap for all applications supporting our data foundation, ensuring alignment with the CDO’s strategic vision. - Business Analysis: Collaborate with key stakeholders across UBS Asset Management to analyze business requirements, define use cases, and translate them into actionable projects. - As-Is Process & Data Flow Analysis: Conduct comprehensive assessments of current data flows, processes, and systems to identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency. - Target Operating Model & Data Architecture Design: Work closely with data engineers and architects to design the target operating model and data architecture that will transform our data management landscape. - Data Analytics & Insights: Leverage data analytics to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data, providing insights that drive business decisions and improve data quality. - Documentation & User Support: Ensure all data systems and processes are well-documented, including process flows, data dictionaries, and user guides. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist end-users during transitions to new platforms.

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist end-users during transitions to new platforms.

• participate in process reviews, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency and mitigate risks

• monitor global and local market trends
• track economic and regulatory developments relevant to energy transition and sustainability
• support networking initiatives through ARC (Analytical Research Community)
