descriptionByLocale.it: Metti sempre i clienti al centro delle tue priorità? Sei appassionato di creare un'atmosfera accogliente e positiva? Per rafforzare il nostro team a Losanna, stiamo cercando un nuovo/nuovo collega come Event Waiting, su richiesta e pagata all'ora (in media circa 65 ore all'anno). In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili di accogliere gli ospiti e fornire un servizio clienti eccellente in vari eventi, come riunioni dei clienti, conferenze stampa o eventi di terze parti che coinvolgono UBS. Sosterrai il direttore dell'evento e svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel garantire la corretta conduzione e sicurezza di ogni evento.
descriptionByLocale.en: Do you always place clients at the centre of your priorities? Are you passionate about creating a welcoming and positive atmosphere? To strengthen our team in Lausanne, we are looking for a new/new colleague as an Event Waiting, on call and paid per hour (about 65 hours per year on average). In this role, you will be responsible for welcoming guests and providing excellent customer service at various events, such as customer meetings, press conferences or third party events involving UBS. You will support the event manager and play a key role in ensuring the proper conduct and safety of each event.
descriptionByLocale.de: Stellen Sie Ihre Kunden immer in den Mittelpunkt Ihrer Prioritäten? Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, eine einladende und positive Atmosphäre zu schaffen? Um unser Team in Lausanne zu stärken, suchen wir einen neuen/neuen Kollegen als Event Waiting, auf Abruf und bezahlt pro Stunde (durchschnittlich ca. 65 Stunden pro Jahr). In dieser Funktion sind Sie für die Begrüßung von Gästen und einen exzellenten Kundenservice bei verschiedenen Veranstaltungen wie Kundenbesprechungen, Pressekonferenzen oder Veranstaltungen von Drittanbietern mit UBS verantwortlich. Sie unterstützen den Eventmanager und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der ordnungsgemäßen Durchführung und Sicherheit jeder Veranstaltung.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Placez-vous toujours les clients au centre de vos priorités? Êtes-vous passionné(e) par la création d’une atmosphère accueillante et positive ? Pour renforcer notre équipe à Lausanne, nous recherchons un(e) nouveau/nouvelle collègue en tant qu’Event Attendant, sur appel et rémunéré(e) à l’heure (environ 65 heures par an en moyenne). Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de l’accueil des invités et de la prestation d’un excellent service client lors de divers événements, tels que des rencontres clients, des conférences de presse ou des événements de tiers impliquant UBS. Vous soutiendrez le/la responsable événementiel et jouerez un rôle clé pour garantir le bon déroulement et la sécurité de chaque événement.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il SAP Project Manager (DI) è responsabile per la consegna controllata delle iniziative SAP S/4HANA Finance all'interno del programma amplificaFi. Il ruolo assicura l'esecuzione disciplinata attraverso la portata, il programma, i rischi e le dipendenze, in linea con gli standard di governance e controllo del progetto UBS, collaborando strettamente con gli stakeholder di Business, Integration e Technology.
• consegna del progetto end-to-end per i flussi di lavoro SAP S/4HANA assegnati.
• stabilire e mantenere robusti piani di progetto, pietre miliari, dipendenze e previsioni.
• guidare il rischio proattivo, l'emissione e la gestione della dipendenza, compresa l'escalation tempestiva.
• applicare UBS-allineed governance, gestione RAID, monitoraggio finanziario e reporting.
• fornire aggiornamenti chiari e concisi delle consegne agli stakeholder senior e alla leadership del programma.
• coordinare la consegna tra i team Business, Integration, Functional, Data, Testing e Distribuzione.
• garantire l'adesione a standard di consegna concordati, decisioni di progettazione e controllo di cambiamento.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The SAP Project Manager (DI) is accountable for the controlled delivery of SAP S/4HANA Finance initiatives within the ampliFi program. The role ensures disciplined execution across scope, schedule, risks, and dependencies, in line with UBS project governance and control standards, partnering closely with Business, Integration, and Technology stakeholders.
• own end‑to‑end project delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA workstreams.
• establish and maintain robust project plans, milestones, dependencies, and forecasts.
• drive proactive risk, issue, and dependency management, including timely escalation.
• apply UBS‑aligned governance, RAID management, financial tracking, and reporting.
• provide clear, concise delivery updates to senior stakeholders and program leadership.
• coordinate delivery across Business, Integration, Functional, Data, Testing, and Deployment teams.
• ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, design decisions, and change control.
descriptionByLocale.de:

• Eigene End-to-End-Projektlieferung für zugeordnete SAP S/4HANA-Workstreams.
• Erstellung und Pflege robuster Projektpläne, Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und Prognosen.
• proaktives Risiko-, Problem- und Abhängigkeitsmanagement, einschließlich zeitnaher Eskalation.
• UBS-orientierte Governance, RAID-Management, finanzielles Tracking und Reporting anwenden.
• Bereitstellung klarer, prägnanter Lieferupdates für leitende Stakeholder und die Programmleitung.
• Koordination der Bereitstellung über Business-, Integrations-, Funktions-, Daten-, Test- und Bereitstellungsteams hinweg.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung vereinbarter Lieferstandards, Designentscheidungen und Änderungskontrolle.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le gestionnaire de projet SAP (DI) est responsable de la prestation contrôlée des initiatives SAP S/4HANA Finance dans le cadre du programme ampliFi. Ce rôle assure une exécution disciplinée dans tous les domaines, le calendrier, les risques et les dépendances, conformément aux normes de gouvernance et de contrôle des projets UBS, en partenariat étroit avec les intervenants du secteur des affaires, de l'intégration et de la technologie.
• l'exécution finale du projet pour les secteurs de travail SAP S/4HANA assignés.
• établir et maintenir des plans de projet robustes, des jalons, des dépendances et des prévisions.
• favoriser une gestion proactive des risques, des problèmes et des dépendances, y compris une escalade rapide.
• appliquer la gouvernance alignée UBS, la gestion RAID, le suivi financier et les rapports.
• fournir des mises à jour claires et concises aux principaux intervenants et aux dirigeants de programme.
• coordonner la prestation des services à l'échelle des équipes d'affaires, d'intégration, de fonctions, de données, de tests et de déploiement.
• assurer le respect des normes de livraison convenues, des décisions de conception et du contrôle du changement.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Role: This role will continue to drive key responsibilities within the STAAT Analytics team. The candidate will lead the development of scalable, insight-driven dashboards and advanced analytical solutions that empower strategic decision-making for financial advisory and market leadership. The role requires a strong ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, ensuring stakeholders have the tools and intelligence needed to optimize performance and identify growth opportunities. Responsibilities :
• Apply a structured, analytical approach to address complex business challenges leveraging Python and SQL.
• Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis and develop predictive models to drive key strategic initiatives.
• Translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications and innovative data-driven solutions.
• Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for real-time KPI tracking across financial advisory and market segments.
• Implement advanced dashboard features such as dynamic filtering, intuitive search functionality, and peer comparison tools to optimize user engagement.
• Integrate data from diverse sources, including ADW, BODI, and internal data marts, ensuring accuracy and consistency across analytics outputs.
• Automate data pipelines and reporting workflows using Python and Power BI, enhancing efficiency and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure analytics deliverables are aligned with overarching business objectives.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about the future of banking through digital transformation and digital assets? Do you see yourself playing an integral part in driving strategic projects and shaping the Group Digital Assets transformation globally? We are seeking an emerging leader to originate, shape, and drive the execution of institutional tokenization initiatives globally across the firm, in close partnership with Investment Bank (IB), Asset Management (AM), Global Wealth Management (GWM), and Personal & Corporate Banking (P&C). This role sits at the intersection of capital markets, regulation, and blockchain-enabled market infrastructure. It is designed for a “rising star” who can identify and translate strategic opportunities into executable, institutionally viable solutions by mobilizing stakeholders across a complex organization. This is not a standalone business development role and not a tokenization platform/product ownership role. Success depends on credibility, influence, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills, and the ability to deliver outcomes across organizational boundaries. Key Responsibilities
• originate and shape institutional tokenization opportunities across IB, AM, GWM, and P&C, converting strategic priorities into concrete initiatives with clear divisional sponsorship and measurable outcomes
• drive end-to-end execution of complex tokenization initiatives, including strategic approach, partner selection, delivery planning, and cross-functional coordination across Product, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Distribution/Coverage
• act as a central orchestrator across divisions, aligning stakeholders and maintaining momentum without direct authority, including managing competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces
• partner closely with internal and external Tokenization Platform Owner/teams (product & infrastructure ownership) to translate institutional requirements into scalable platform capabilities, while maintaining clear decision rights and separation between origination/structuring and platform ownership
• plan and support negotiation of strategic partnerships with key ecosystem participants (e.g., custodians, infrastructure providers, tokenization agents, administrators, exchanges), ensuring commercial, operational, and regulatory viability
• integrate regulatory, governance, and risk considerations into initiative design and execution, ensuring institutionally robust pathways to market across relevant jurisdictions
• establish and improve repeatable execution patterns (governance, templates, workstreams, decision forums, milestones) to increase delivery velocity and transparency across initiatives
• represent the firm credibly in key discussions with internal and external executive stakeholders as required by the initiative (e.g., institutional clients, strategic partners, industry forums), focused on delivery and scalable structures Additional US Responsibility
• act as a key interface to regional management in the US, ensuring a coherent and executable Digital Assets strategy by aligning global priorities with regional market, regulatory, and client requirements What Success Looks Like (12–18 months)
• a sponsor-backed portfolio of priority ecosystem initiatives across IB, AM, GWM, and P&C with clear governance, decision rights, and delivery milestones
• progress 2–3 cross-divisional tokenization initiatives from concept through structured delivery planning to executed launch or a defined go-live pathway, depending on complexity and jurisdiction
• a repeatable “institutional tokenization playbook” covering structuring patterns, partner archetypes, risk/compliance pathways, and execution routines
• demonstrable stakeholders pull: divisions proactively bring opportunities because the role accelerates delivery rather than creating friction

descriptionByLocale.en:
We're looking for a Municipal Credit Strategist to:
• Provide municipal credit coverage across various sectors including utilities (electric and water/sewer), transportation (toll roads/airports), private higher education, and select high profile and special‑situation credits.
• Provide timely and independent municipal research via written commentary, presentations, and client‑facing materials.

• Offer in-depth coverage of specific credits during periods of market stress, reprioritizing quickly as events unfold.
• Work closely with municipal sales and financial advisors to deliver timely, actionable credit views.
• Respond efficiently to inbound inquiries, balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé. En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :
• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

Laufen Sie zur Hochform auf, wenn Sie ein Team leiten? Wissen Sie, wie man Kundinnen und Kunden betreut und Ziele erreicht? Wir suchen eine neue Kollegin oder einen neuen Kollegen für folgende Aufgaben:

descriptionByLocale.it:

• ensure the occurrence of errors and operational problems are minimized, promptly and properly document any issues that occur

Vuoi giocare un ruolo chiave nel trasformare la nostra azienda in un'organizzazione agile? A UBS, ri-immaginamo il modo in cui lavoriamo, il modo in cui ci colleghiamo – i nostri colleghi, clienti e partner – e il modo in cui forniamo valore. Essere agili ci renderà più reattivi, più adattabili, e alla fine più innovativi. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative. We’re looking for a Cloud Developer with Database Products expertise to:
• part of Database Product Agile POD to develop and improve database infrastructure services mainly PostgreSQL and Databases on Azure Cloud.
• provide infrastructure services that are easy to consume and efficient to operate, making effective use of cloud capabilities (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)

• ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non-functional requirements

• passionate technologist with continuous learning record and leadership edge to bring difference
• learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind

Chez UBS, nous réimaginons la façon dont nous travaillons, la façon dont nous nous connectons les uns avec les autres – nos collègues, nos clients et nos partenaires – et la façon dont nous offrons de la valeur. Être agile nous rendra plus réactifs, plus adaptables et finalement plus innovants. Mansioni - partie de Database Product Agile POD pour développer et améliorer les services d'infrastructure de base de données principalement PostgreSQL et Bases de données sur Azure Cloud. - fournir des services d'infrastructure faciles à consommer et efficaces à exploiter, en utilisant efficacement les capacités du cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) - appliquer un large éventail de pratiques d'ingénierie, allant de l'analyse des exigences et du développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités à l'automatisation par la conception, les essais automatisés, le déploiement et l'infrastructure en tant que code - assurer la qualité, la sécurité, la fiabilité et la conformité des solutions en appliquant nos principes numériques et en mettant en œuvre des exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles - intégrer l'observation dans nos solutions, surveiller la santé de la production, aider à résoudre les incidents et remédier à la cause profonde des risques et des problèmes
• Requisiti - technologue passionné avec un record d'apprentissage continu et un avantage de leadership pour apporter la différence - apprendre de nouvelles technologies et pratiques, réutiliser des plates-formes et des normes stratégiques, évaluer les options et prendre des décisions en tenant compte de la durabilité à long terme
• Cosa offriamo - Oui. Contatto

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your role : Do you have the perfect pitch? Do you follow the markets, even in your spare time? We’re looking for an investment advisor to:
• Work closely with the Premium Advisory Specialist team in Taiwan & APAC
• Act as the dedicated portfolio specialist for clients with UBS Advice Premium Mandates, providing comprehensive investment advice across various asset classes, guided by Chief Investment Office's Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation

• Pro-actively contact clients with meaningful portfolio updates and provides investment recommendations within a portfolio context and a disciplined / risk-controlled framework
• Responsible for timely and adequate execution, confirmation and supervision of orders given by the client
• Follow developments in the financial markets to maintain an understanding of both current and anticipated trends across relevant markets and asset classes

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for an Analyst responsible for ensuring the timely and accurate processing of transactions and events. This includes booking, pre matching, settlement, filing, archiving, and handling internal and external queries.
The role also covers transaction and position reconciliations and may include cash management, payment activities, and the resolution of client service issues.

Key Responsibilities/ As an Analyst, you will be expected to:
• Execute assigned processes and controls in a timely, accurate, and complete manner
• Perform preparatory work, transaction processing, control checks, and reconciliation tasks
• Ensure full compliance with legal, regulatory, and statutory requirements, as well as internal policies and contractual obligations
• Identify, understand, and manage the risks associated with your business and function
• Collaborate across teams and functions to deliver the most effective solutions and courses of action

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about performing research, analyzing data and coding up improvements to complex algorithmic trading strategies? We're looking for someone to analyze, adapt and improve the quantitative performance of UBS’s suite of agency algorithmic trading and smart order routing strategies. The successful candidate will primarily:
• perform thorough research on areas such as market microstructure and market impact analysis.
• perform Transaction Costs Analysis (TCA) to minimize executions costs.
• improve consistency of algo performance and reduce outliers and risk, particularly during significant unscheduled as well as scheduled events e.g. index rebalance events.
• design and spec new trading strategies with a particular focus on low latency trading strategies.
• analyze trading patterns and trends within market data (L2 or L3 format).
• employ modern data analytical tools such as machine learning but in a controlled and practical way.
• adapt algorithms to adjust to new markets, venues, order types, asset classes and regulation.
• generate intraday trading signals and volume forecasts from microseconds to minutes.
• communicate with internal stakeholders and external clients and vendors to understand business requirements and market trends.
• produce analytics and reports to monitor and benchmark trading performance both internally and for clients

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are looking for an Analyst responsible for ensuring the timely and accurate processing of transactions and events. This includes booking, pre matching, settlement, filing, archiving, and handling internal and external queries. The role also covers transaction and position reconciliations and may include cash management, payment activities, and the resolution of client service issues. Key Responsibilities/ As an Analyst, you will be expected to:
• Execute assigned processes and controls in a timely, accurate, and complete manner
• Perform preparatory work, transaction processing, control checks, and reconciliation tasks
• Ensure full compliance with legal, regulatory, and statutory requirements, as well as internal policies and contractual obligations
• Identify, understand, and manage the risks associated with your business and function
• Collaborate across teams and functions to deliver the most effective solutions and courses of action

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have a strong trading / technology / analytical background with in-depth knowledge of equity markets and market micro-structure?
UBS is looking for an Electronic Agency Algorithmic Trader to:

• manage the quantitative parameters that drive the overall algorithmic behavior
• provide daily interaction with the equity trading desks, quantitative analysts, and clients to adjust parameters on the back of stock specific news and in advance of special event days to ensure algorithm behavior is aligned with client and market expectations
• apply client specific configuration that enhance client/algorithm specific behavior, manage and prioritize product enhancements, risk management, and conduct data driven analysis to automate and optimize the trading platform and workflows
• manage releases and custom algorithm solutions and provide Real Time management of trading risk and intraday monitoring of the algorithms across all business types, products, and clients
• be responsible for direct interaction with the developers and quantitative analysts surrounding improvement to the algorithmic products including analytics and research
• interact with execution consultants who work directly with external clients to optimize and improve trading experience with UBS
• act as an electronic trading subject matter expertise with ability to serve as real time source of information to users of electronic trading product both internally & externally

descriptionByLocale.it:
Revolutionize Wealth Management with AI We’re building modern, world-class AI products that help our Wealth Management advisors serve clients better. You will be responsible for executing our AI strategy and ideating in the rapidly evolving environment of enterprise AI. This is inclusive of chatbots as well as agentic solutions all with the goal of “codifying investment advice” for our advisors and saving them time. You’ll own outcomes end to end, lead people, and partner closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Product Marketing to ship experiences advisors love. What you’ll do:
• Own an AI product portfolio end to end: define strategy, shape roadmaps, and deliver advisor facing capabilities (e.g., productivity tools, advisor workflows, insights & analytics, chat/assistive tools).
• Define products & features: Develop and maintain technical requirements, user stories, and design documents for product features.
• Design delightful experiences: partner with UX to drive elegant, usable flows; insist on research and measurable UX outcomes
• Ship with quality and compliance: collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Legal, and Compliance to meet regulatory and supervisory expectations in wealth management.
• Lead and develop people: hire, coach, and performance manage PMs/POs (and/or cross functional squads); raise the bar on product craft.
• Tell the story: translate complex concepts into crisp narratives for senior stakeholders; influence prioritization with data (adoption, CSAT, etc).
• Continuously improve: instrument, test, learn; run experiments and iterate to drive advisor productivity and client outcomes.
• Analyze trends: Analyze user behavior, market trends, and competitor activity to inform product decisions.
• Scale operating rigor: own backlogs, OKRs, metrics, release readiness, and business change (training, comms, enablement).

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role Are you passionate about directly impacting the largest wealth management business in the world by utilizing AI? Do you want to play a key role in build AI and machine learning models to generate meaningful and actionable insights, improve decision making, optimize the business process, and help address business problems? Are you excited about opportunities Generative AI can bring for Wealth Management? We are looking for a Data Scientist to:
• work with stakeholders to identify opportunities to leverage AI and machine learning to support Wealth Management business
• use Generative AI and agentic systems to improve business outcomes

titleByLocale.it: Product Manager, Soluzioni Digitali e AI

descriptionByLocale.it:
Revolutionize Wealth Management with Digital Solutions & AI Are you passionate about harnessing innovative technologies and artificial intelligence to drive innovation and growth? Do you have experience in developing AI-powered products that transform industries? We're building a cutting-edge suite of products, including machine learning and natural language processing to drive competitive advantage for our financial advisors. As a Product Manager, Digital Solutions & AI, you'll play a crucial role in shaping this suite of products and driving their success. Here's what you'll do:
• Own AI but also other digital technology products end-to-end, both internally developed as well as vendor products (e.g M365 Copilot)
• Contribute to the AI product roadmap and serve as a subject matter expert for these products
• Communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clear understanding of benefits and trade-offs.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams (technology, data science, marketing, training, UX, compliance, risk etc) to ensure seamless execution for all products under your responsibility.
• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and researchers to develop and implement products & features that meet customer needs.
• Analyze user behavior, market trends, and competitor activity to inform product decisions.
• Develop and maintain technical requirements, user stories, and design documents for product features.
• Conduct demos and internal training sessions for new products and features

• manage the quantitative parameters that drive the overall algorithmic behavior

• act as an electronic trading subject matter expertise with ability to serve as real time source of information to users of electronic trading product both internally & externally

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you will help oversee risk across the lending portfolio and support the day to day management of client exposures. Your responsibilities will include:

- perform holistic analysis of loan and derivative exposures which requires understanding of collateral, derivative products, risk methodologies and stress test reports
- identifying potential credit and derivatives related risks and escalating observations to senior stakeholders in a timely manner
- assisting with discussions relating to derivatives such as margin calibration, liquidity thresholds, etc.
- supporting the setup and monitoring of financial conditions and covenants for the lending transactions of some of UBS’ most sophisticated wealth management clients
- contributing to risk mitigation and remediation discussions for individual transactions and portfolios
- utilising AI‑enabled analytics to provide portfolio insights, risk summaries and ad-hoc analyses for management internal stakeholders.

descriptionByLocale.en:
• Are you gifted at assessing value and risk? Do you love to give advice, as well as educate? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
• – conduct company research and valuation analysis in listed Korean banks and financial institutions
• – analyze key banking metrics (e.g., NIM, asset quality, capital adequacy, loan growth) to derive clear investment insights
• – build and maintain financial models for banks and financial institutions, including earnings forecasts, balance sheet projections, and capital analysis
• – compare valuation and market price to draw sensible and understandable investment opinions
• – provide investment recommendations based on modeling, valuation and risk assessments in an effective, convincing manner
• – develop and maintain cooperative professional relationship with portfolio managers
• – remain current on market developments to help frame investment strategies
• – stay up to date on macro trends, regulatory changes, interest rate movements, and financial sector developments to support investment strategies

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us at UBS Group as Regulatory Reporting and Fund Administration Specialist in the Gestora from which you will be supporting the team in Madrid office within the Global Wealth Management division.

You will support to the team in tasks such as:
• Prepare and submit periodic regulatory statements and reports required by the CNMV and other official bodies (including, among others: confidential regulatory statements, statistical reports, AIFMD/UCITS reporting, Bank of Spain).
• Coordinate data collection with internal areas (portfolio management, risk, accounting, depositary, back office).
• Ensure consistency, completeness, and traceability of reported information.
• Manage corrections, clarifications, and information requests from the CNMV.
• Monitor regulatory changes affecting SGIIC regulatory reporting and support related IT adaptations.
• Participate in the continuous improvement of reporting processes and tools.
• Invoice management and control, including review, posting, and payment follow-up.
• Bank reconciliations and review of account movements of Collective Investment Institutions
(CIIs).
• Operational management of transfers, subscriptions, and redemptions of CIIs, in coordination with the depositary and other involved parties.
• Monitoring operational incidents and resolving discrepancies.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you comercially driven, client-focused, and energized by closing deals? Do you enjoy structuring lending solutions and partnering closely with Client Advisors to grow revenue? We are looking for a Lombard and Mortgage Lending Specialist to:

- actively originate and drive Lombard and mortgage lending opportunities, partnering with Client Advisors from initial client discussions through to deal execution and closure
- provide subject matter expertise in residential mortgage lending, applying a strong understanding of the regulatory framework to ensure transactions comply with local regulations and internal credit policies.
- act as deal captain for complex lending transactions, structuring appropriate client solutions, assessing risks and mitigants, and preparing high‑quality credit submissions
- promote the suitable and sustainable use of lending solutions to Client Advisors, clients, and internal stakeholders
- drive sales momentum and conversion by identifying lending opportunities within existing and new client relationships
- provide guidance on pricing and structuring for complex lending transactions, applying sound commercial judgement
- contribute to asset growth and loan interest income through proactive marketing efforts and participation in client meetings
- build and maintain strong internal partnerships by continuously coaching Client Advisors and collaborating with Credit Risk Control and Investment Product teams
- continuously improve our lending and deposit offerings to better meet evolving client needs
descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei guidato comercialmente, focalizzato sul cliente, ed energizzato chiudendo le offerte? Ti piace strutturare soluzioni di prestito e collaborare a stretto contatto con i Client Advisor per aumentare i ricavi? Stiamo cercando uno specialista di prestiti lombardo e mortgage a:

- originare e guidare attivamente opportunità di prestito lombardo e mutuo, collaborando con i Client Advisors dalle discussioni iniziali del cliente attraverso per affrontare l'esecuzione e la chiusura
- fornire competenze in materia di credito ipotecario residenziale, applicando una forte comprensione del quadro normativo per garantire le transazioni conformi alle normative locali e le politiche di credito interno.
- fungere da capitano di accordi per operazioni complesse di prestito, strutturare soluzioni client appropriate, valutare i rischi e mitiganti, e preparare sottomissioni di credito di alta qualità
- promuovere l'uso adeguato e sostenibile delle soluzioni di prestito a consulenti, clienti e stakeholder interni
- impulso di vendita e conversione, identificando le opportunità di prestito all'interno delle relazioni esistenti e dei nuovi clienti
- fornire indicazioni sui prezzi e sulla strutturazione per operazioni di prestito complesse, applicando un giudizio commerciale valido
- contribuire alla crescita degli asset e al reddito degli interessi dei prestiti attraverso gli sforzi di marketing proattivo e la partecipazione alle riunioni dei clienti
- costruire e mantenere forti partnership interne allenando continuamente i Client Advisors e collaborando con i team di Credit Risk Control e Investment Product
- migliorare continuamente le nostre offerte di prestito e deposito per soddisfare meglio le esigenze dei clienti in evoluzione
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie Comercial-getrieben, Client-fokussiert und durch Abschluss-Angebote aktiviert? Genießen Sie die Strukturierung von Kreditlösungen und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenberatern, um Umsatz zu steigern? Wir suchen einen Lombard und Mortgage Lending Spezialist für:

- aktiv starten und fahren Lombard und Hypothekenkredite Möglichkeiten, die Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenberatern von ersten Kundengesprächen bis hin zur Abwicklung und Schließung
- Bereitstellung von Fachkenntnissen in der Hypothekenkreditierung von Wohnimmobilien, die Anwendung eines starken Verständnisses des Regulierungsrahmens, um sicherzustellen, dass Transaktionen den lokalen Vorschriften und internen Kreditpolitiken entsprechen.
- fungieren als Dealkapitän für komplexe Kredittransaktionen, die Strukturierung geeigneter Kundenlösungen, die Bewertung von Risiken und Mitiganten und die Vorbereitung qualitativ hochwertiger Kreditbeiträge
- die angemessene und nachhaltige Nutzung von Kreditlösungen für Kundenberater, Kunden und interne Interessenvertreter fördern
- Steigerung der Verkaufsdynamik und Umstellung durch die Identifizierung von Kreditmöglichkeiten innerhalb bestehender und neuer Kundenbeziehungen
- Leitlinien für die Preisgestaltung und -strukturierung bei komplexen Kreditgeschäften zur Anwendung einer soliden wirtschaftlichen Beurteilung
- Beitrag zu Vermögenswachstum und Kreditzinserträgen durch proaktive Marketingbemühungen und Beteiligung an Kundensitzungen
- Aufbau und Pflege starker interner Partnerschaften durch ständiges Coaching von Kundenberatern und Zusammenarbeit mit Credit Risk Control and Investment Product Teams
- kontinuierlich verbessern unsere Kredit- und Einzahlungsangebote, um den wachsenden Kundenbedürfnissen besser gerecht zu werden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous dirigé par le client et énergisé par la conclusion de contrats ? Vous aimez structurer les solutions de prêt et vous associer étroitement avec les conseillers clients pour augmenter les revenus? Nous recherchons un spécialiste des prêts hypothécaires et lombard pour :

- proviennent activement et stimulent les opportunités de prêt hypothécaire et lombard, en partenariat avec les conseillers clients des discussions initiales des clients jusqu'à l'exécution et la clôture des contrats
- fournir une expertise en matière de prêts hypothécaires résidentiels, en appliquant une bonne compréhension du cadre réglementaire pour assurer que les transactions sont conformes aux règlements locaux et aux politiques internes de crédit.
- agir à titre de capitaine de transaction pour des opérations de prêt complexes, structurer les solutions client appropriées, évaluer les risques et les mitigants, et préparer des soumissions de crédit de haute qualité
- promouvoir l'utilisation appropriée et durable des solutions de prêt auprès des conseillers clients, des clients et des intervenants internes
- stimuler la dynamique des ventes et la conversion en identifiant les possibilités de prêt dans les relations client existantes et nouvelles
- fournir des orientations sur la tarification et la structuration pour les opérations de prêt complexes, en appliquant un jugement commercial solide
- contribuer à la croissance des actifs et aux intérêts sur les prêts grâce à des efforts de marketing proactifs et à la participation aux réunions de clients
- établir et maintenir des partenariats internes solides en formant continuellement les conseillers clients et en collaborant avec les équipes de contrôle des risques de crédit et de produits d'investissement
- améliorer continuellement nos offres de prêts et de dépôts pour mieux répondre aux besoins changeants des clients

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a seasoned risk manager and can provide challenge to senior management in their risk decisions? Do you enjoy working in teams and contribute to the sustainable risk management of the business? Then we are looking for someone like you! In your new role you will:
• Provide 1st line advice and policy interpretation to Markets on AML related matters in line with regulatory expectations and global/regional policies, framework and guidance; assisting Markets with the articulation and assessment of AML risks to guide Markets in their decision making.
• Provide 1st line guidance to Markets on Level 2 queries2 for individual cases, providing practical advice and potential solutions to address identified AML/CFT risks for individual cases. Where needed, supporting Markets in their discussions with DDO on escalated Level 2 cases on a prioritized basis.
• Partner with OH and C&ORC to uplift Markets capabilities on AML/CFT topics by developing materials (e.g. scenario guidance), providing relevant training, sharing feedback through lessons learnt, and sharing of industry best practices.
• Support Markets from a 1st line risk perspective in timely completion of remediation programs, including, where appropriate, providing appropriate management reporting and advice around risks, issues & dependencies.
• present key updates to management including risks, issues & dependencies in appropriate forums and provide guidance on mitigation
• be a role model to your team of risk partners
• help drive a positive risk culture throughout the organization including driving and delivering selected trainings

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nell'ambito del Global Markets Client Office, contribuirai a plasmare e fornire la nostra strategia clienti in tutta la Global Markets Distribution, generando ricavi in uscita, vincendo quote di mercato e migliorando l'esperienza del cliente. Potrai agire come un connettore centrale tra i clienti e l'azienda, assicurando che portiamo la piattaforma UBS completa ai clienti senza silo bias. Metterete il cliente al centro del processo decisionale: identificare la parte delle lacune del portafoglio, privilegiare le giuste opportunità, e trasformare la comprensione in risultati commerciali misurabili. Potrai lavorare all'intersezione di dati, AI, vendite, trading e senior management, traducendo analisi in azione attraverso forum disciplinati, campagne e migliori in esecuzione di classe. Informare. Attiva. Eseguite. In questo ruolo, voi:
• guidare campagne client di asset cross e iniziative regionali per i clienti prioritari: opportunità sul posto, coordinare l'esecuzione e tracciare i risultati
• fornire analisi chiare e su larga scala sulle lacune del portafoglio, le prestazioni della campagna e le tendenze tematiche per informare la strategia e migliorare i risultati
• agire come la voce del cliente eseguendo le recensioni e i forum dei clienti interni strutturati con Sales & Trading e le parti interessate senior, catturando intuizioni, accettando azioni e assicurandosi di seguire attraverso
• supporta i principali client che vengono forniti attraverso la gestione del conto (ferma all'impegno costante, nuovo PM onboard, discussioni strategiche, escalation e connettività continua)
• organizzare recensioni di broker, recensioni di broker inversa e eventi cliente finiscono per finire (pianificazione, materiali, logistica e azioni)
• generare un'intelligenza client attiva utilizzando strumenti avanzati di analisi e di intelligenza artificiale emergenti; contribuire alla progettazione, alla sperimentazione e all'implementazione delle capacità di Sales AI
• produrre materiali concisi, senior ready—briefings, report di performance e presentazioni che sono orientate alle decisioni e facili da consumare
• contribuire a costruire prodotti AI che incorporano intuizioni proattive, automazione e supporto decisionale direttamente nei flussi di lavoro di vendita
descriptionByLocale.en:
As part of Global Markets Client Office, you will help shape and deliver our client strategy across Global Markets Distribution—driving revenue outperformance, winning market share and improving the client experience. You’ll act as a central connector between clients and the firm, ensuring we bring the full UBS platform to clients without silo bias. You will put the client at the centre of decision making: identifying share of wallet gaps, prioritising the right opportunities, and turning insight into measurable commercial outcomes. You will work at the intersection of data, AI, sales, trading and senior management—translating analytics into action through disciplined forums, campaigns and best in class execution. Inform. Enable. Execute. In this role, you will:
• drive cross asset client campaigns and regional initiatives for priority clients—spot opportunities, coordinate execution and track outcomes
• deliver clear, large scale analytics on wallet gaps, campaign performance and thematic trends to inform strategy and improve results
• act as the Voice of the Client by running structured internal client reviews and forums with Sales & Trading and senior stakeholders—capturing insights, agreeing actions and ensuring follow through
• support key client deliverables across account management (firm to firm engagement, new PM onboarding, strategic discussions, escalations and ongoing connectivity)
• organise broker reviews, reverse broker reviews and client events end to end (planning, materials, logistics and actions)
• generate actionable client intelligence using advanced analytics and emerging AI tools; contribute to the design, testing and rollout of Sales AI capabilities
• produce concise, senior ready materials—briefings, performance reports and presentations that are decision oriented and easy to consume
• help build AI products that embed proactive insights, automation and decision support directly into sales workflows

Vous travaillerez à l'intersection des données, de l'IA, des ventes, du trading et de la haute direction, transformant l'analyse en action à travers des forums disciplinés, des campagnes et la meilleure exécution de classe. title: Head of Greater China Institutional Client Coverage

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Greater China Institutional Client Coverage
titleByLocale.en: Head of Greater China Institutional Client Coverage
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Greater China Institutional Client Coverage
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Greater China Institutional Client Coverage

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have the knowledge and experience to drive the business (development) with our Greater China client base? Do you have a track record of successfully managing client relationships? Are you able to create collaborative solutions in challenging and complex situations? If so, we are looking for a strong candidate to join our Institutional Client Coverage team in HK to lead and grow our institutional asset management business in Greater China, very much as a player / coach. You will lead and work closely with the incumbent Client Relationship Managers in our Greater China Institutional business. The role will focus on shaping the business strategy for Greater China and growing our institutional business in the region across the UBS AM capability set. This will be done in conjunction with the incumbents. You (and your team) will be accountable for the delivery of agreed business targets and maximise (new) client mandates by leveraging industry knowledge, internal and external contacts and relationships. Key responsibilities
• a key role in shaping our strategy for Greater China
• player / coach in growing our Greater China business, leading and closely working with incumbents
• increase corporate & market awareness of the Greater China business, including the promotion of UBS AM at key events and roadshows as required
• contribute strongly to the team’s prospecting activity as a player. Leverage existing and new relationships to grow / diversify our book and achieve growth ambitions for the business
• work closely with the investment teams in both public and private markets, and Partnership Solutions and represent UBS Asset Management and UBS Group as such to organisations across the region
• management of the new business pipeline with the team and delivery of a thorough and organised process to ensure delivery of high quality & timely RfPs; pre pitch intelligence, internal preparation and briefings
• work closely across the firm, leveraging our capabilities in global markets, global banking and wealth management to ensure we deliver OneUBS to our clients

descriptionByLocale.it:
Un CRB Quant Trader è responsabile dello sviluppo di modelli quantitativi e della gestione dell'esecuzione sistematica di scambi e ordini su base principale. Il ruolo si concentra sulla generazione di ricavi, fornendo liquidità ai clienti, e supportando le esigenze dei clienti attraverso il rischio disciplinato e la gestione dei capitali. Responsabilità chiave:
• Generare entrate attraverso lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione tempestiva/accurata e la prenotazione di scambi/ordini su base principale (generando P&L)
• Tenere attivo il controllo degli sviluppi del mercato e delle opportunità di trading; avere una forte comprensione dei mercati finanziari, degli strumenti e delle strategie
• Facilitare il flusso dell’ordine del cliente fornendo liquidità tramite inventario proprietario (utilizzando il capitale dell’azienda) o accedendo a offerte esterne di terzi
• Adeguarsi a tutte le normative e politiche interne applicabili, tra cui ma non limitata alla qualità dell'esecuzione (esempio: migliore esecuzione), attività di trading (esempio: Volcker), prezzi, hedging, trading-limits e politiche di conformità
• Gestire una vasta gamma di rischi, inclusi ma non limitati al rischio di trading, al rischio di esecuzione, al rischio operativo, al rischio di conformità e al rischio di condotta ecc., valutare le opzioni e prendere decisioni
• Seguire, rispettare e promuovere i principi e comportamenti UBS che agiscono con integrità, dovuta abilità, cura e diligenza sempre
• Assicurare l'escalation e la divulgazione di qualsiasi informazione di cui i regolatori applicabili si aspetterebbero ragionevolmente
• Osservare gli standard adeguati di condotta di mercato, pagando a causa degli interessi dei clienti e trattandoli in modo equo
• Nel caso di supervisione di altri membri del personale, garantire l'aderenza alle normative e alle politiche interne applicabili tramite un'efficace supervisione e supervisione con riferimento ai principi di buona vigilanza Consegna chiavi:
• Generazione delle entrate (trading P&L, commissioni, crediti di vendita) e crescente business dei clienti con la liquidità
• Forte contributo allo sviluppo di modelli regionali/globali che guidano il business CRB
• osservanza di regolamenti, politiche di conformità, politiche di scrivania e linee guida applicabili a ciascun mercato
• Gestione del rischio
• Condurre in conformità con i principi e i comportamenti UBS insieme alle aspettative normative, tra cui l'escalation e la divulgazione di questioni rilevanti
descriptionByLocale.en:
A CRB Quant Trader is responsible for developing quantitative models and managing the systematic execution of trades and orders on a principal basis. The role focuses on generating revenue, providing liquidity to clients, and supporting client needs through disciplined risk and capital management. Key Responsibilities:
• Generate revenue through development and timely/accurate execution and booking of trades/orders on a principal basis (generating P&L)
• Proactively keep abreast of market developments and trading opportunities; have a strong understanding of financial markets, instruments, and strategies
• Facilitate client order flow by providing liquidity via proprietary inventory (utilizing the firm’s capital) or accessing third party external offerings
• Adhere to all applicable regulations and internal policies including but not limited to quality of execution (example: best execution), trading activities (example: Volcker), pricing, hedging, trading-limits and compliance policies
• Manage broad range of risks, including but not limited to trading risk, execution risk, operational risk, compliance risk and conduct risk etc., evaluating options and making decisions
• Follow, adhere to and promote the UBS principles and behaviours acting with integrity, due skill, care, and diligence always
• Ensure escalation and disclosure of any information of which applicable regulators would reasonably expect notice
• Observe proper standards of market conduct while paying due regard to interests of customers and treating them fairly
• Where supervising other members of staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations and internal policies via effective supervision and oversight with reference to the Principles of Good Supervision Key Deliverables:
• Revenue generation (trading P&L, commissions, sales credits) and growing client business by provision of liquidity
• Strong contributions towards development of regional/global models driving the CRB business
• Adherence to regulations, compliance policies, desk policies, and guidelines as applicable to each market
• Risk management
• Conduct in accordance with UBS principles and behaviours along with regulatory expectations including escalation and disclosure of relevant issues
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ein CRB Quant Trader ist für die Entwicklung von quantitativen Modellen verantwortlich und verwaltet die systematische Ausführung von Handel und Aufträgen grundsätzlich. Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Erzeugung von Einnahmen, die Bereitstellung von Liquidität für Kunden und die Unterstützung von Kundenbedürfnissen durch diszipliniertes Risiko und Kapitalmanagement. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:
• Umsatzermittlung durch Entwicklung und rechtzeitige/genaue Ausführung und Buchung von Waren/Aufträgen auf einer Hauptbasis (Erzeugung von P&L)
• Proaktiv bleiben Marktentwicklungen und Trading-Möglichkeiten; haben ein starkes Verständnis der Finanzmärkte, Instrumente und Strategien
• Erleichterung des Kundenauftragsdurchflusses durch Bereitstellung von Liquidität über proprietäre Inventar (unter Nutzung des Unternehmenskapitals) oder Zugang zu externen Angeboten Dritter
• Bewahren Sie sich an alle geltenden Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die Qualität der Ausführung (Beispiel: beste Ausführung), Handelsaktivitäten (Beispiel: Volcker), Preis-, Sicherungs-, Handels- und Compliance-Politiken
• Verwalten eines breiten Spektrums von Risiken, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Handelsrisiko, Ausführungsrisiko, operationelles Risiko, Compliance-Risiko und Verhaltensrisiko usw., Bewertungsoptionen und Entscheidungen
• Befolgen, betreuen und fördern die UBS-Prinzipien und Verhaltensweisen, die mit Integrität, Due Skill, Sorgfalt und Sorgfalt handeln, immer
• Sicherstellung der Eskalation und Offenlegung von Informationen, von denen die anwendbaren Regulierungsbehörden vernünftigerweise eine Mitteilung erwarten würden
• Beobachten Sie die richtigen Standards des Marktverhaltens und zahlen Sie gebührend die Interessen der Kunden und behandeln sie fair
• Bei der Betreuung anderer Mitarbeiter sorgen die Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften und der internen Politiken durch eine wirksame Aufsicht und Aufsicht unter Bezugnahme auf die Grundsätze der Guten Aufsicht Schlüssellieferungen:
• Umsatzerzeugung (Handel mit P&L, Provisionen, Verkaufskrediten) und wachsendes Kundengeschäft durch Bereitstellung von Liquidität
• Starke Beiträge zur Entwicklung regionaler/globaler Modelle, die das CRB-Geschäft vorantreiben
• Einhaltung von Vorschriften, Compliance-Richtlinien, Schreibtischrichtlinien und Richtlinien für jeden Markt
• Risikomanagement
• Verhalten nach UBS-Grundsätzen und Verhaltensweisen sowie regulatorische Erwartungen einschließlich Eskalation und Offenlegung relevanter Fragen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Un négociant CRB Quant est chargé de développer des modèles quantitatifs et de gérer l'exécution systématique des ordres et des ordres sur une base principale. Le rôle consiste à générer des revenus, à fournir des liquidités aux clients et à répondre aux besoins des clients par une gestion rigoureuse du risque et du capital. Principales responsabilités :
• Générer des recettes grâce au développement, à l'exécution et à la réservation en temps opportun et précis des transactions/commandes sur une base principale (production de P&L)
• Se tenir au courant de l'évolution des marchés et des débouchés commerciaux; avoir une bonne compréhension des marchés financiers, des instruments et des stratégies
• Faciliter le flux de commandes client en fournissant des liquidités via des stocks propriétaires (utilisant le capital de l'entreprise) ou en accédant à des offres externes tierces
• Adhérer à tous les règlements et politiques internes applicables, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la qualité de l'exécution (exemple: meilleure exécution), les activités commerciales (exemple: Volcker), la tarification, la couverture, les limites commerciales et les politiques de conformité
• Gérer un large éventail de risques, notamment le risque de négociation, le risque d'exécution, le risque opérationnel, le risque de conformité et le risque de conduite, etc., évaluer les options et prendre des décisions
• Suivre, respecter et promouvoir les principes et comportements de l'UBS agissant avec intégrité, compétence, soin et diligence
• Veiller à l'escalade et à la divulgation de toute information dont les autorités compétentes pourraient raisonnablement s'attendre à un avis;
• Respecter les normes de conduite du marché tout en tenant dûment compte des intérêts des clients et en les traitant équitablement
• Lorsqu'il supervise d'autres membres du personnel, veiller au respect des règlements et des politiques internes applicables par le biais d'une supervision et d'un contrôle efficaces eu égard aux principes de bonne surveillance Principaux produits livrables :
• Génération de revenus (trading P&L, commissions, crédits de vente) et croissance des activités clientes par apport de liquidités
• Des contributions fortes au développement de modèles régionaux/mondiaux qui animent les activités du CRB
• Respect des règlements, des politiques de conformité, des politiques administratives et des lignes directrices applicables à chaque marché
• Gestion des risques
• Respecter les principes et les comportements de l'UBS ainsi que les attentes réglementaires, y compris l'escalade et la divulgation des questions pertinentes

titleByLocale.it: Stewardship Analista – Corporate Governance & Active Ownership

titleByLocale.de: Stewardship Analyst – Corporate Governance & Active Ownership

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about Sustainable Investing and in particular Investor Stewardship? Investor stewardship is a core component of UBS Asset Management’s fiduciary and sustainable investing approach. We are seeking an experienced Stewardship Analyst to strengthen our corporate governance, proxy voting and engagement capabilities across global investments. In this role you will:
• act as a corporate governance subject matter expert, providing independent, high quality analysis on boards, executive remuneration, shareholder rights, capital structures and governance risks across global markets
• apply deep governance expertise to inform voting decisions, company engagement priorities and investment discussions
• assess company practices in a global and competitive context, including peer benchmarking and evolving governance and ESG standards
• lead end to end proxy voting research and execution, ensuring voting decisions are robust, policy aligned and clearly articulated
• demonstrate strong hands on experience with proxy voting systems, voting workflows and data quality management
• contribute to the ongoing development and application of UBS Asset Management’s global proxy voting policies
• conduct in depth engagements with senior board members and executive management on governance and material ESG topics
• engage confidently on complex and sensitive issues, including executive pay, board effectiveness, succession planning and long term strategy
• integrate broader ESG considerations into engagement activity, including climate, nature, social issues and emerging areas such as AI governance
• work closely with active and passive investment teams, ensuring stewardship insights are well integrated into investment decision making
• support portfolio managers and analysts with governance and ESG insights relevant to risk assessment and long term value creation
• contribute to stewardship reporting and respond to internal and client stewardship related queries
• help drive innovation in stewardship research and processes, including exploring opportunities to integrate AI and advanced analytics into voting and engagement research
• contribute to continuous improvement of stewardship frameworks, analytical tools and engagement practices.

• collaborate closely with issuers, internal and external legal advisors, regulatory authorities, clearing and settlement organizations, and origination teams
• coordinate all involved parties and manage tasks that arising throughout the lifecycle of a debt transaction

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise? We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives. The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required

Are you an analytical thinker and interested in how political and economic events impact credit risk of the bank? Are you experienced with applying macro-economic concepts and analyzing political and policy risks? At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other - our colleagues, clients and partners - and the way we deliver value. • – assign country risk ratings in line with internal rating guidelines and methodologies, identify emerging risks, key triggers and potential rating sensitivities in a timely manner
• – support the team in the development and maintenance of internal methodologies, data and tools for country and comparative analyses
• – interact with specialists in different areas to drive upgrades of the internal framework and processes

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a detail-oriented multi-tasker? Do you like solving problems and identifying process improvements and efficiencies? Do you enjoy working in a global team? We’re looking for a dynamic and tech-savvy Management Support Officer to join our Global Investments Business Management team. This team supports the Investments function globally, collaborating with executive assistants in our regional hubs to deliver high-quality administrative support and drive operational consistency. This role goes beyond administrative support responsibilities — we are looking for someone who thrives on efficiency, embraces innovation, and is excited to make a real impact by optimizing how our team works. You’ll be the go-to person in Poland for executive support, process improvement, and operational excellence. If you love solving problems, automating workflows, and keeping things running smoothly, we want to hear from you! Key responsibilities:
• Administrative Support: - calendar management, - meeting scheduling, - agenda preparation, - logistics coordination, - email communications, - travel booking, - expense processing - gifts and entertainment tracking.
• Operational & Technical Tasks: - workforce planning, - employee onboarding and offboarding initiation and tracking, - organizational unit maintenance, - HRi updates, system administration and support, - MDS request management, - BBS resource ownership, and liaison with teams across the global Investments organization.
• Process Optimization: - identify opportunities to standardize and automate repetitive tasks and workflows, - troubleshoot issues, and solve problems proactively. Leverage tools like Microsoft Copilot, SharePoint, and Teams to improve speed and accuracy.
• Communications & Collaboration: - prepare internal communications, - coordinate training sessions, - maintain and update organizational charts, - support cross-team and project collaboration.

Are you a detail-oriented multi-tasker? Do you like solving problems and identifying process improvements and efficiencies? Do you enjoy working in a global team? We’re looking for a dynamic and tech-savvy Management Support Officer to join our Global Investments Business Management team. This team supports the Investments function globally, collaborating with executive assistants in our regional hubs to deliver high-quality administrative support and drive operational consistency. An Investment Associate provides support to the wealth management team in the analysis and marketing of products and services, alongside client service.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS is seeking a highly motivated Associate to join its Leveraged Finance Origination team in London. The team is responsible for the origination, structuring, underwriting and syndication of leveraged loan and high yield bond financings for financial sponsor and corporate clients across EMEA. As an Associate, you will play a central role in executing transactions, supporting senior bankers in client coverage, and managing deal processes from origination through distribution. The role offers significant exposure to private equity sponsors, corporate management teams, investors, and internal risk partners, and requires strong analytical capability, commercial judgment, and execution discipline. Key Responsibilities include: Transaction Execution
• Support the structuring and execution of leveraged loans, high yield bonds and related financing solutions for sponsor backed and corporate transactions, including LBOs, acquisitions, refinancings and recapitalisations
• Coordinate deal execution across internal stakeholders including coverage, credit risk, syndicate, legal and operations teams Financial Analysis & Modelling
• Build and review detailed financial models, including LBO, cash flow, leverage and covenant analyses
• Assess credit profiles, capital structures and debt capacity across a range of industries and business models Credit & Risk Management
• Prepare credit approval materials and present recommendations to internal credit committees
• Act as a first line of defense in assessing underwriting, market and distribution risk Marketing & Syndication
• Produce high quality pitch books, information memoranda and investor presentations
• Assist in the syndication of underwritten transactions, including managing investor feedback, order books and roadshow logistics Client & Sponsor Interaction
• Support senior bankers in client and sponsor dialogue, including transaction structuring discussions and market updates
• Contribute to idea generation and development of financing solutions tailored to client objectives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you comfortable working in a second line of defense role, able to provide independent analysis and an “effective challenge” to the 1LoD, while remaining pragmatic? Are you able to react quickly and with sound judgment, balancing business objectives with legal, regulatory, and ethical requirements? In this role, you will support second line of defense (2LoD) Operational Risk and Compliance activities for Global Wealth Management (GWM) as well as for support functions (HR, Finance, Operations, etc.). You will work under the supervision of the Head of Operational Risk Control (ORC) and senior team members, contributing to risk monitoring, risk assessments, reporting, and control activities, while developing your expertise in non-financial risks. This role is particularly suited to a junior profile looking to build a strong foundation in operational risk, compliance, and regulatory matters within a structured environment. Your responsibilities
• Support Operational Risk Control and Compliance (second line of defense) activities for GWM and support functions at the local level.
• Contribute to the implementation and monitoring of the non-financial risk framework, in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Participate in key risk management processes (RCSA, incidents, Front-to-Back controls, risk appetite) and ensure escalation of identified risks.
• Prepare and consolidate reporting, risk analyses, and governance materials, as well as track remediation action plans.
• Support second-level controls, thematic reviews (AML/KYC, fraud, suitability, etc.), and interactions with audit and regulatory authorities.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms? We’re looking for an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain the extension of the functionality within analytics libraries used for valuation and risk management of UBS’ interest rate, credit, and hybrid derivatives business for business and regulatory requirements. Triage with the trading, IT, and control functions to provide support on modeling and quantitative matters.
• Provide analytical and quantitative support for trading desks that deal with several types of products including all linear interest rate products such as Swaps, Futures, and Government Securities; all Interest Rate Option products including Swaptions, Caps & Floors, exchange traded options; all Structured Rates products including Bermudan Options, Callable Notes, Range Accruals, and Leveraged Steepeners among others; and Structured Hybrid products including the underlying Interest Rate/FX/Equity indices.
• Code mathematical models in our C++ libraries and on tools using Python, Excel/VBA. Contribute to regulatory and model governance requirements by writing model documentation with technical/mathematical descriptions using LaTex and detailed tests using Python within our documentation framework.
• Provide support and input to the trading desk in usage of our stochastic-volatility Model, the SABR model, and related risk functionality including interest rate volatility risk, skew/smile, and interest rate risk measures. Support the interest rate options trading desk’s end of day model publishing and calibration processes. Tasked with investigations of day-to-day risk-based P&L attribution and explanation of any unexplained P&L and for generating solutions and improvements.
• Work in Python to provide the trading desk with various visualization and relative value tools to aid them with the pricing and marking of models. Be involved with the migration of our books to a strategic trading and risk management platform. Implement new pricing methodologies and modeling enhancements to the stochastic volatility model and SABR model in our C++ libraries to support Options and Structured Rates businesses.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote). Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 002879. NO CALLS PLEASE. descriptionByLocale.en:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms? We’re looking for an Associate Director, Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain the extension of the functionality within analytics libraries used for valuation and risk management of UBS’ interest rate, credit, and hybrid derivatives business for business and regulatory requirements. Triage with the trading, IT, and control functions to provide support on modeling and quantitative matters.
• Provide analytical and quantitative support for trading desks that deal with several types of products including all linear interest rate products such as Swaps, Futures, and Government Securities; all Interest Rate Option products including Swaptions, Caps & Floors, exchange traded options; all Structured Rates products including Bermudan Options, Callable Notes, Range Accruals, and Leveraged Steepeners among others; and Structured Hybrid products including the underlying Interest Rate/FX/Equity indices.
• Code mathematical models in our C++ libraries and on tools using Python, Excel/VBA. Contribute to regulatory and model governance requirements by writing model documentation with technical/mathematical descriptions using LaTex and detailed tests using Python within our documentation framework.
• Provide support and input to the trading desk in usage of our stochastic-volatility Model, the SABR model, and related risk functionality including interest rate volatility risk, skew/smile, and interest rate risk measures. Support the interest rate options trading desk’s end of day model publishing and calibration processes. Tasked with investigations of day-to-day risk-based P&L attribution and explanation of any unexplained P&L and for generating solutions and improvements.
• Work in Python to provide the trading desk with various visualization and relative value tools to aid them with the pricing and marking of models. Be involved with the migration of our books to a strategic trading and risk management platform. Implement new pricing methodologies and modeling enhancements to the stochastic volatility model and SABR model in our C++ libraries to support Options and Structured Rates businesses.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote). Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 002879. NO CALLS PLEASE. descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you an expert in researching credit investment opportunities? Do you have any experience in leveraged loans and high yield bonds? Are you good at making investment recommendations based on your assessments? We are looking for Research Analyst Leveraged Loans & High Yield Bonds to
• conduct fundamental credit analysis on leveraged loans and high yield bonds, including detailed review of financial statements, operating performance, and credit risk drivers
• build and maintain financial models to project cash flows, assess leverage, covenant compliance, and downside scenarios
• prepare high quality investment memoranda and support Portfolio Managers during Investment Committee discussions with clear analysis and recommendations
• evaluate new primary market opportunities by reviewing offering materials, attending management or bank calls, and assessing deal terms and documentation
• monitor secondary market positions, tracking performance, pricing, and credit developments, and flagging risks or opportunities to the investment team
• support ongoing portfolio monitoring by updating models, preparing credit reviews, and contributing to risk, valuation, and investor reporting

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand?

Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done?

We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

descriptionByLocale.it: As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented operations professional with strong accounting and reconciliation experience who can identify exceptions, research issues, and help maintain a high-quality experience for branch and business stakeholders by: Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly. Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise? We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives. The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required
